title: Trump says Board of Peace has reached agreement for disarmament of Hamas
english: President Donald Trump has announced that a deal has been reached to disarm Hamas and other militant groups in Gaza as part of a phased peace plan. While the plan involves the eventual withdrawal of Israeli forces and the establishment of a new Palestinian governing authority, both Hamas and Israel have expressed significant reservations or have yet to officially commit. The transition process is expected to rely on international forces and a newly formed Palestinian police force to ensure local security.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በጋዛ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የሃማስ እና ሌሎች ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ትጥቅ እንዲፈቱ የሚያስችል ስምምነት መደረሱን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ዕቅድ የእስራኤል ጦር ከጋዛ እንዲወጣ እና አዲስ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር እንዲቋቋም የሚያደርግ ደረጃ በደረጃ የሚተገበር ሂደት ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ሃማስ እና እስራኤል በዚህ ስምምነት ላይ እስካሁን ግልጽ የሆነ ድጋፍ አልሰጡም፤ የጋራ ደህንነትን ለማስከበርም ዓለም አቀፍ ኃይል እና አዲስ የፍልስጤም ፖሊስ እንደሚሰማሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp gareen Hamaas fi gareewwan hidhattoota biroo Gaazaa keessa jiran meeshaa waraanaa akka hiikan walii galtee irra ga’ameera jechuun beeksisaniiru. Karoorri kun waraanni Israa’eel akka Gaazaa gadhiisu fi bulchiinsi haaraan kan Falasxiin akka hundaa’u kan gaafatu yoo ta’u, dhimmichi sadarkaa sadarkaan kan raawwatamu ta’a. Ta’us, Hamaas fi Israa’eel walii galtee kanarratti hamma ammaatti yaada ifaa hin kennine; nageenya naannichaa eeguufis humnoonni idil-addunyaa fi poolisiin Falasxiin haaraan akka gurmaa’an ibsameera.

title: UK left-wing MP Diane Abbott reinstated by Labour Party after suspension
english: The British Labour Party has officially reinstated veteran MP Diane Abbott, restoring her status as a party member after a year-long suspension. Her return follows an independent review process that addressed her controversial past remarks regarding racism and the Israeli military. This decision coincides with a recent leadership change within the party, as new Prime Minister Andy Burnham moves to separate his administration from the policies of his predecessor.
amharic: የብሪታንያ የሌበር ፓርቲ አንጋፋዋን የፓርላማ አባል ዳያን አቦትን ከአንድ አመት እገዳ በኋላ በይፋ ወደ ፓርቲው መልሷቸዋል። ውሳኔው የተላለፈው ዘረኝነትን እና የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን በተመለከተ በሰጡት አወዛጋቢ አስተያየቶች ላይ ገለልተኛ ምርመራ ከተካሄደ በኋላ ነው። ይህ እድገት ፓርቲው አዲስ መሪ እና ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃምን ከሾመ በኋላ የተከሰተ ሲሆን፣ አዲሱ አስተዳደር ከቀድሞው አመራር ፖሊሲዎች ለመራቅ ጥረት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Paartiin Labour kan Biritish miseensa parlamaa durii Daayaan Aaboot waggaa tokkoof dhorkamanii turan booda gara paartichatti deebiseera. Deebiin isaanis ibsa isaan kanaan dura dhimma sanyummaa fi waraana Israa'el irratti kennan ilaalchisee qorannoo bilisa ta'e booda kan murtaa'edha. Murtoon kun kan dhufu hogganaan paartichaa fi Ministirri Muummee haaraan Andii Barnhaam gaggeessummaa fudhatanii erga hojiin isaanitti gammadanii booda yommuu ta'u, kunis mootummaan isaanii siyaasa hogganaa durii irraa adda ba'uuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: Pathirage challenges Chopra-Nadeem javelin rivalry in Commonwealth final
english: Sri Lankan athlete Rumesh Pathirage has emerged as the favorite for the Commonwealth Games javelin final after a dominant qualifying performance. While the event is traditionally highlighted by the rivalry between India's Neeraj Chopra and Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem, both veterans have struggled with injuries recently. Pathirage enters the competition with strong momentum, aiming to surpass the existing tournament record held by Nadeem.
amharic: የስሪላንካው አትሌት ሩመሽ ፓቲራጅ በኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች የጦር ውርወራ ፍጻሜ ዋንጫውን ለማሸነፍ ቀዳሚ ግምት አግኝቷል። ምንም እንኳን የውድድሩ ትኩረት በህንዳዊው ኒራጅ ቾፕራ እና በፓኪስታናዊው አርሻድ ናዲም መካከል ባለው ፉክክር ላይ ቢሆንም፣ ሁለቱም አትሌቶች በጉዳት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ስር ሆነዋል። ፓቲራጅ በውድድሩ ላይ ባሳየው ድንቅ ብቃት ቀደም ሲል ናዲም ያስመዘገበውን ክብረ ወሰን ለመስበር ግቡን ሰንቋል።
oromo: Atileetiin biyya Srilanka Rumesh Pathirage dorgommii darbachuu warannoo (javelin) tapha Commonwealth irratti injifachuuf nama abdatame ta'ee jira. Dorgommiin kun durii kaasee falmmii atileetota Indiyaa Neeraj Chopra fi Paakistaan Arshad Nadeem gidduutti godhamuun beekama, ta'us lameenuu miidhaa qaamaa irra turuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Pathirage qophii gaarii taasiseedhaan rekardii duraan Nadeem qabatee ture cabsuuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jira.

title: US appeals court rejects Trump expansion of mandatory migrant detention
english: A federal appeals court in San Francisco has ruled against the Trump administration's policy of denying bond hearings to immigrants arrested within the U.S. This decision creates a legal conflict with other courts that previously supported the policy, increasing the probability that the Supreme Court will have to intervene. The administration's mandate, which forces the detention of noncitizens without the option for release, remains a central point of contention in the ongoing debate over national immigration enforcement.
amharic: ሳን ፍራንሲስኮ የሚገኝ አንድ የፌዴራል ይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት፣ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ ውስጥ የታሰሩ ስደተኞች በዋስ የመለቀቅ መብት እንዳይኖራቸው ያወጡትን ደንብ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከዚህ ቀደም ተመሳሳይ ደንብን ከደገፉ ሌሎች ፍርድ ቤቶች ጋር የህግ አለመግባባት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ ወደ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የመሄድ እድሉን ከፍ አድርጎታል። ያለ ዋስትና ስደተኞችን በእስር ለማቆየት የሚደረገው የመንግስት ጥረት በአሜሪካ የስደተኞች ህግ ላይ አነጋጋሪ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa San Fransiskoo, bulchiinsi Trump godambaa biyya keessatti qabaman mormiin akka gadhiifaman hayyamu akka hin qabne murtii kenne mormeera. Murtii kanaan walqabatee, manneen murtii biroo duraan murtoo kana deggaraa turan wajjin wal-dhabdeen uumameera; kunis dhimmi kun gara mana murtii olaanaa biyyattii akka deemu carraa guddisa. Namoota biyya alaa ta'an kaffaltii mallattoo tokko malee hidhaa keessatti tursuuf yaalii bulchiinsi kun taasisu, falmii seera godambaa irratti irratti ka'e keessatti iddoo guddaa qabateera.

title: Trump administration appeals to never-before-used court for deportation
english: The Trump administration has utilized a specialized legal body known as the Alien Terrorist Removal Court for the first time since its creation in 1996. Prosecutors are attempting to deport Nazira Haji Zada, a legal U.S. resident, by linking her to a thwarted election-day plot involving her sons, despite her facing no formal criminal charges. Critics argue that this legal move bypasses standard due process protections and relies on classified evidence that remains hidden from public view.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከ1996 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ተመስርቶ ጥቅም ላይ ያልዋለውን ልዩ የሽብርተኝነት ማስወገጃ ፍርድ ቤት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ስራ አስገብቷል። መንግስት በህጋዊ መንገድ በአሜሪካ የምትኖር ናዚራ ሃጂ ዛዳን በልጆቿ ላይ በተጠረጠረ የሽብር ሴራ ተሳትፋለች በሚል ለማባረር እየሞከረ ቢሆንም፣ በሴትየዋ ላይ የቀረበ የወንጀል ክስ የለም። ይህ እርምጃ የዜጎችን መብት የሚጥስ እና ለህዝብ ይፋ በማይደረግ ሚስጥራዊ ማስረጃ ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው በሚል ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Traamp mana maree seeraa kan bara 1996 hundeeffamee hanga har’aatti hojii irra hin oolin, ‘Alien Terrorist Removal Court’ jedhamu yeroo jalqabaaf fayyadameera. Mootummaan, Nazira Haji Zadaa isheen jiraattuu Ameerikaa seera qabeettii taate, ijoollee ishee waliin walqabatee karoora badii raawwachuuf yaalame keessatti harka qabdi jechuun biyyattii irraa arii’uuf tattaaffachaa jira; ta’us ishee irratti himannaan yakkaa tokko illee hin banamne. Gochi kun mirga dhaddacha seeraa kabachiisuu akka cabsu fi ragaa icitii ta’e kan ummataaf hin ibsamne irratti hundaa’uun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Trump says Board of Peace reaches agreement on disarmament of Hamas in Gaza
english: President Donald Trump announced that a newly formed Board of Peace has successfully negotiated a deal to disarm Hamas and other militant groups in Gaza. As part of this phased agreement, Israeli forces are expected to withdraw from the territory, which will then be overseen by an international force and a new Palestinian governing body. While Hamas has been in positive talks with mediators in Cairo, the group has yet to provide an official public comment on the specific disarmament terms.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ 'የሰላም ቦርድ' የተባለ ተቋም የሃማስን እና ሌሎች የጋዛ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት ስምምነት ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቀዋል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት የእስራኤል ጦር ከጋዛ ለቆ እንደሚወጣ እና በምትኩ አለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል እና አዲስ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር ስልጣኑን እንደሚረከቡ ተገልጿል። ሃማስ በካይሮ ከሚገኙ አደራዳሪዎች ጋር አወንታዊ ውይይት እያደረገ ቢሆንም፣ ስለ ትጥቅ መፍታቱ ስምምነት እስካሁን ይፋዊ መግለጫ አልሰጠም።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp, 'Boordiin Nagaa' jedhamu tokko gareen Haamaas fi gareewwan hidhatan biroo Gaazaa keessatti akka hidhannoo hiikatan walii galtee irra ga'uu isaa beeksisaniiru. Walii galtee sadarkaa sadarkaan raawwatamu kanaan, waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadhiisee kan ba'u yoo ta'u, bakka isaas humni nageenyaa idil-addunyaa fi bulchiinsi haaraan kan bakka bu'u ta'a. Haamaas Kaayirootti qaamolee giddu-galeessa ta'an waliin marii gaarii gochaa kan jiru ta'us, hanga ammaatti waa'ee walii galtee hidhannoo hiikachuu kanaa ibsa ifa ta'e hin kennine.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is deeply rooted in a social culture that treats questioning authority as an act of disloyalty. From the home to the classroom and the workplace, individuals are conditioned to value blind obedience over critical thinking. This rigid hierarchy stifles open dialogue and keeps citizens from challenging flawed systems, which ultimately hinders the country's broader democratic progress.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ እጦት ችግር ሥር የሰደደው ሥልጣንን መቃወም እንደ ታማኝነት ማጉደል በሚታይበት ማህበራዊ አመለካከት ነው። በቤተሰብ፣ በትምህርት ቤት እና በሥራ ቦታዎች ሰዎች የነቃ አስተሳሰብን ከመጠቀም ይልቅ ለበላይ አካላት ያለ ጥያቄ እንዲገዙ ይገፋፋሉ። ይህ አድሎአዊ እና ጥብቅ የሆነ የአሰራር ስርዓት ግልጽ ውይይትን በማፈን ዜጎች ጉድለቶችን እንዳይጠይቁ በማድረግ የዴሞክራሲ ግንባታን ያደናቅፋል።
oromo: Rakkoon demokrasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu aadaa hawaasummaa aangoo gaaffii keessa galchuu akka amanamummaa dhabuu kan ilaalu irratti hundaa'a. Mana keessaa hanga mana barnootaa fi bakka hojiitti, namoonni yaada bilisaa fi of danda'e qabaachuu mannaa, aangoo qaban hundaaf bitaa-tokkoon ajajamuu akka qaban baratu. Caasaan giddu-galeessummaa cimaa ta'e kun marii bilisaa ukkaamsuun, lammiileen rakkoolee sirnaa akka hin dubbanne taasisuun guddina demokrasii biyyattii duubatti harkisa.

title: Amazon’s Zoox secures US federal approval for steering-wheel-free robotaxis
english: Amazon’s autonomous vehicle company, Zoox, has received federal approval to operate robotaxis that lack traditional steering wheels or pedals. The U.S. government granted this exemption based on the company's strong safety performance, allowing them to begin commercial passenger services in Las Vegas. While this marks a significant milestone for self-driving technology, Zoox must still meet local requirements and maintain strict reporting on vehicle safety.
amharic: የአማዞን የራስ ገዝ ተሽከርካሪ ኩባንያ የሆነው ዙክስ (Zoox) መሪ ወይም ብሬክ የሌላቸው ታክሲዎችን በንግድ አገልግሎት ለማዋል የፌዴራል ፈቃድ አግኝቷል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት ለኩባንያው የደህንነት ብቃት ሲባል ልዩ ፈቃድ የሰጠው ሲሆን፣ ይህም በላስ ቬጋስ ለተጠቃሚዎች ክፍያ የሚጠይቅ አገልግሎት እንዲጀምሩ ያስችላቸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ለራስ-አሽከርካሪ ቴክኖሎጂ ትልቅ ምዕራፍ ቢሆንም፣ ኩባንያው አሁንም የአካባቢውን ህጎች ማሟላት እና ስለ ተሽከርካሪዎቹ ደህንነት ወቅታዊ መረጃዎችን ማቅረብ ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni konkolaataa ofiin of-hafaru kan Amazon, Zoox jedhamu, isteeringii ykn miilaan to'atamu kan hin qabne taaksiiwwan robotii fayyadamuuf hayyama federaalaa argateera. Mootummaan Amerikaa nageenya konkolaatichaa irratti hundaa'uun hayyama addaa kenneefii, kunis magaalaa Laas Veegasitti kaffaltiidhaan tajaajila abbaa qabeenyaa akka jalqaban isaan taasisa. Tarkaanfiin kun teeknooloojii konkolaataa ofiin of-hafaruuf milkaa'ina guddaa ta'us, dhaabbatichi seera naannoo kabajee fi odeeffannoo nageenya konkolaataa yeroo yeroon dhiyeessuun irra jiraata.

title: Why is US GDP growth slowing, and how can it be reversed?
english: US economic growth slowed to 1.5 percent in the second quarter of 2026, down from 2.1 percent earlier this year. This decline is largely driven by a widening trade deficit and higher oil prices caused by new tariff policies and global supply shocks. While the country is spending heavily on technology and AI infrastructure, stagnant exports and reduced international trade cooperation are hindering overall economic momentum.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ እድገት በ2026 ሁለተኛ ሩብ ዓመት ከነበረበት 2.1 በመቶ ወደ 1.5 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል። ይህ መቀዛቀዝ በዋናነት የመጣው የንግድ ልውውጥ ጉድለት በመስፋፋቱ እና በተጣሉ የንግድ ታሪፎች ምክንያት የነዳጅ ዋጋ በመጨመሩ ነው። አሜሪካ በቴክኖሎጂ እና በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ዘርፍ ከፍተኛ ኢንቨስትመንት ብታደርግም፣ የወጪ ንግድ መቀነስ እና አለም አቀፍ የንግድ ግንኙነት መዳከም እድገቷን እየጎዳው ይገኛል።
oromo: Guddinni dinagdee Ameerikaa bara 2026 kurmaana lammaffaatti irra turee gara dhibbeentaa 1.5 tti gad bu'eera. Hir'inni kun kan dhufeyyuu hir'ina daldalaa dabalaa deemuufi gatii boba'aa dabaleen walqabatee akkasumas daangaa daldalaa haarawaafi jeequmsa dhiyeessii addunyaa irraan kan ka'edha. Ameerikaan teeknoolojiifi damee 'AI' irratti invastimantii guddaa gochaa jirtus, gurgurtaan biyya alaa hir'achuufi hariiroon daldalaa biyyoota biraa waliin jiru laafachuun guddina dinagdee biyyattii miidhaa jira.

title: French teen fined in Singapore over ‘straw licking’ stunt
english: A French teenager was ordered to pay a fine of approximately $465 in Singapore after admitting to a public nuisance offense. The young man gained notoriety online after recording a video of himself licking a straw and returning it to a juice vending machine. He pleaded guilty to the charges following the incident.
amharic: በሲንጋፖር የሚኖር አንድ የፈረንሳይ ታዳጊ በህዝብ ቦታ መረበሽ ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ በመገኘቱ ወደ 465 የአሜሪካ ዶላር የሚጠጋ ቅጣት ተጥሎበታል። ታዳጊው አንድ የጭማቂ ማሽን ውስጥ ያለን ገለባ ልሶ መልሶ በማስቀመጡ የተወሰደውን የቪዲዮ ምስል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በማሰራጨቱ ነው ለዚህ ቅጣት የተዳረገው። በድርጊቱም ወንጀለኛ መሆኑን አምኗል።
oromo: dargaggeessi lammii Faransaay tokko biyya Singaappooritti, gocha seeraan alaa raawwateen kaffaltii dolaara 465 ta'u akka kaffalu murtaa'eef. Dargaggeessi kun ulee dhugaatii (straw) tokko erga arrabsee booda mishiina dhugaatii keessa deebisee kaawwachuu isaa viidiyoo gadi lakkisee ture. Gocha kana raawwachuu isaa erga amanee booda, yakka namoota biratti muddama uumuu irratti himatamee adabameera.

title: Argentina’s Milei seeks to deport foreigners that spread ‘hate’ of country
english: Argentinian President Javier Milei has issued an emergency decree allowing the government to deport or ban foreigners who speak against the country or its national symbols. The move follows international criticism and allegations of racism directed at Argentina's players and fans during the 2026 World Cup. Legal experts have questioned whether the decree is constitutional, while the government maintains it is necessary to defend the nation's reputation.
amharic: የአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዚዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ በሀገሪቱ ወይም በብሔራዊ ምልክቶች ላይ ጥላቻን የሚያሰራጩ የውጭ ዜጎችን በሀገሪቱ እንዳይኖሩ ወይም እንዲባረሩ የሚያስችል አዲስ ድንገተኛ አዋጅ አውጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው እ.ኤ.አ በ2026 የዓለም ዋንጫ ወቅት በአርጀንቲና ተጫዋቾች እና ደጋፊዎች ላይ የቀረቡትን የዘረኝነት ውንጀላዎች ተከትሎ ነው። የህግ ባለሙያዎች በአዋጁ ህጋዊነት ላይ ጥያቄ እያነሱ ሲሆን መንግስት ግን የሀገሪቱን ክብር ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ ነው ብሏል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Arjentiinaa Javier Milei, namoota biyya isaa ykn mallattoolee biyyattii irratti jibbaa facaasan biyyattii keessaa baasuu ykn dhorguuf aayii ariifachiisaa ta’e baasee jira. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga waancaa addunyaa bara 2026 booda taphattootaa fi deggertoota Arjentiinaa irratti komiin jibbaa fi loogii sanyummaa erga dhiyaatee booda dha. Ogeeyyonni seeraa seera qabeessummaa labsichaa irratti shakkii kan qaban yoo ta’u, mootummaan garuu kabaja biyyattii eeguuf murtoon kun dirqama dha jedhee amana.

title: Trump says ‘Board of Peace’ reaches Gaza disarmament deal
english: President Donald Trump announced that a group known as the Board of Peace has finalized a deal to disarm Hamas and other militant factions in Gaza. This disarmament process is expected to occur in several stages. Once completed, the agreement aims to facilitate the full withdrawal of Israeli military forces from the region.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ 'የሰላም ቦርድ' የተባለ አካል በጋዛ የሚገኙ የሃማስ ታጣቂዎችን እና ሌሎች የትጥቅ ቡድኖችን ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት ስምምነት ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የትጥቅ ማስፈታት ሂደት በደረጃ የሚከናወን ይሆናል። ሂደቱ ሲጠናቀቅ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ይወጣሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp gareen 'Board of Peace' jedhamu gareelee hidhattoota Gaza keessa jiran hidhanno hiikkachiisuuf waliigalteerra gahuu isaa ibsaniiru. Hojiin hidhannoo hiikkachiisuu kun sadarkaa sadarkaan kan raawwatamu ta'a. Hojiin kun yoo xumuramu waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadi lakkisee akka bahuuf karoorfameera.

title: Israel carries out demolitions near Unesco site in Lebanon
english: Israeli forces have destroyed parts of an underground tunnel network located near the historic Beaufort Castle in southern Lebanon. The medieval site, which is recognized by UNESCO, has been under Israeli control since May of this year. This strategic fortress offers a clear view of the surrounding areas in both Lebanon and Israel.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ታሪካዊው የቦፎርት ቤተመንግስት አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ የምድር ውስጥ ዋሻዎችን አፍርሰዋል። በዩኔስኮ የተመዘገበው ይህ የ900 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለው ጥንታዊ ግንብ፣ ከግንቦት ወር ጀምሮ በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ይገኛል። ይህ ስልታዊ ቦታ በሊባኖስ እና በእስራኤል ድንበር አካባቢ ሰፊ እይታን የሚሰጥ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el lafa jala gurguddaa ta'an kan gubbaa fi lafa jala dhokatanii jiran kan naannoo gamoo seena-qabeessa Boforti (Beaufort Castle) kibba Liibaanoositti argamu diiganiiru. Gamoon kun kan UNESCOtiin beekamtii argate yoo ta'u, ji'a Caamsaa darbee kaasee harka Israa'el jira. Iddoon kun bakka tarsiimoo cimaa ta'e kan naannawa Liibaanoos fi Israa'elirratti hordoffii taasisuuf gargaaruudha.

title: Saudi Arabia condemns drone attack on ships in Egyptian port
english: Saudi Arabia has officially denounced a recent drone strike that ignited fires on two vessels docked at an Egyptian port. The Saudi government declared its complete support for Egypt and backed any actions taken by the country to maintain its national security and borders. This statement emphasizes the strong diplomatic ties and solidarity between the two nations following the hostile act.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በግብፅ ወደብ ላይ በሁለት መርከቦች ላይ የደረሰውን የድሮን ጥቃት በጥብቅ አውግዛለች። የሳዑዲ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ከግብፅ ጎን እንደሚቆም በመግለጽ፣ አገሪቱ ሉዓላዊነቷን እና ደህንነቷን ለመጠበቅ የምትወስደውን ማንኛውንም እርምጃ እንደሚደግፍ አስታውቋል። ይህ መግለጫ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የቅርብ ግንኙነትና የአጋርነት ስሜት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa buufata doonii Gibxii keessatti dooniiwwan lama irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin qabneen raawwatame balaaleffatteetti. Mootummaan Saudii Gibxii waliin dhaabbachuu isaa ibsuun, nageenyaa fi kabajamuu biyyattii tiksuuf Gibxiin tarkaanfii fudhattu kamiyyuu akka deggeru beeksiseera. Ibsi kun walitti dhufeenya cimaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Opinion: Ben Gvir's crocodiles are the latest weapon in Israel's animal warfare on Palestinians
english: Israel's National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has announced a controversial plan to station Nile crocodiles as guards at the Ketziot prison. To enable this, the government has reclassified the crocodiles as cultivated wild animals. The reptiles are intended to be placed in moats surrounding the facility where Palestinian detainees are held.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በኬትዚዮት እስር ቤት የናይል አዞዎችን እንደ ዘበኛ ለመጠቀም እቅድ እንዳላቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህንን እቅድ ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ መንግስት አዞዎችን እንደ ሰለጠኑ የዱር እንስሳት በይፋ ፈርጇቸዋል። እነዚህ አዞዎች ፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞች በሚገኙበት እስር ቤት ዙሪያ ባሉ የውሃ ቦዮች ውስጥ እንዲቀመጡ ታቅዷል።
oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gviir, mana hidhaa Keetziyoottitti eegumsaaf qocaa malkaa (Nile crocodiles) fayyadamuuf karoora qabaachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Karoora kana milkeessuuf, mootummaan qocaa malkaa kana akka bineensa bosonaa leenji'eetti ramadeera. Qocaaleen kunis hidhamtoota Palastiin itti hidhamanitti marsanii akka eeganiif galaana mana hidhichaa marsu keessatti akka gadhiifaman karoorfameera.

title: Iraq says it neither approved nor had prior knowledge of US-Saudi strikes
english: The Iraqi government has stated that it was not informed and did not authorize recent military strikes conducted by the United States and Saudi Arabia within its borders. These operations targeted groups supported by Iran, which were accused of launching drone attacks against Saudi oil infrastructure. Baghdad's official response highlights a lack of coordination regarding these foreign military actions on its soil.
amharic: የኢራቅ መንግስት በአገሩ ግዛት ውስጥ በአሜሪካ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ የተካሄደውን የአየር ጥቃት አስቀድሞ እንደማያውቅና ፈቃድም እንዳልሰጠ አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የሳውዲ አረቢያን የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች በድሮን በመታ ስልጣን የተከሰሱ ኢራን የሚደግፋቸው ቡድኖች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። የባግዳድ መግለጫ በአገሪቱ ግዛት ላይ ስለተፈጸሙት የውጭ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ቅንጅት አለመኖሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraaq tarkaanfii waraana Ameerikaafi Sa'udii Arabiyaan biyyattii keessatti fudhataniif beekamtis ta'ee hayyama hin kennine jedhe. Tarkaanfiin kun garee Iraaniin deggeraman kanneen bu'uuraalee misooma boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeessuun himataman irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. ibsi kunis tarkaanfiiwwan waraanaa biyya alaa biyyattii keessatti gaggeeffaman irratti waliigalteen akka hin turre agarsiisa.

title: Will Saudi Arabia be dragged further into the war in Iran?
english: Saudi Arabia, working alongside the United States, recently conducted airstrikes against Iranian-linked paramilitary groups inside Iraq. Riyadh justified these attacks by claiming the militia was responsible for targeting its oil infrastructure. These developments have sparked significant tensions, leading to warnings of a broader regional escalation.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከአሜሪካ ጋር በመተባበር በኢራቅ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። ሪያድ ይህን እርምጃ የወሰደችው ታጣቂዎቹ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎቿን ኢላማ በማድረጋቸው ምክንያት ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በቀጠናው ያለውን ውጥረት በማባባስ፣ ግጭቱ ወደ ሌሎች አካባቢዎች ሊዛመት ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan waliin dhaha Amerikaan, garee hidhattoota Iraan waliin hidhata qaban kan Iraaq keessa jiran irratti haleellaa qilleensaa raawwatteetti. Riyad haleellaa kana kan raawwatte, hidhattoonni kunneen buufataalee boba’aa ishee irratti haleellaa geessisaniiru himannaa jedhuun dha. Gochi kun naannichatti sodaafi walitti bu’iinsa kaasuun, waraanni kun bal’achuuf akka maluuf yaaddoo uumee jira.

title: Prague Zoo keeps polar bears cool with ice amid heatwave
english: Prague Zoo is helping its polar bears cope with a severe heatwave in Europe by providing them with large amounts of ice. The twin bears, Aluet and Gregor, were seen enjoying the cooling treat inside their enclosure. This effort is part of the zoo's strategy to keep the animals comfortable during the extreme summer temperatures.
amharic: በፕራግ የሚገኝ መካነ አራዊት በአውሮፓ እያጋጠመ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ለመቋቋም ለዋልታ ድቦቹ ብዙ መጠን ያለው በረዶ እያቀረበ ይገኛል። አሌውት እና ግሪጎር የተባሉት መንታ ድቦች በረት ውስጥ በተቀመጠላቸው በረዶ በመጫወት ቀዝቃዛ ጊዜን አሳልፈዋል። መካነ አራዊቱ እንስሳቱ በከፍተኛ ሙቀት እንዳይጎዱ ይህን እርምጃ ወስዷል።
oromo: Zoo-n Praag argamu tokko, qilleensi hoo'aan Awurooppaa keessatti mudate sun bineensota isaa irratti miidhaa akka hin geessisneef, dhakuma harree (polar bears) sanaaf cabbii baay'ee dhiyeessaa jira. Dhakoonni harree gosa 'Aluet' fi 'Gregor' jedhaman cabbii isaaniif dhiyaate kana keessa taphachuudhaan hoo'a sana dandamachaa jiru. Kuni gocha zoo-n kun bineensota isaa hoo'a hamaa kana irraa ittisuuf godhaa jiruudha.

title: UN launches hunt for next chief amid rising challenges
english: The United Nations has officially begun the search for a new Secretary-General to succeed Antonio Guterres. An initial informal poll identified Rebeca Grynspan as a leading candidate, though several others are vying for the position. The next leader will face the difficult task of reforming the organization while addressing global conflicts and waning international influence.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የአንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝን ቦታ የሚረከብ አዲስ ዋና ጸሃፊ ለማግኘት የፍለጋ ሂደቱን ጀምሯል። የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ መደበኛ ባልሆነ ድምጽ አሰጣጥ የኮስታሪካዋ የቀድሞ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ረቤካ ግሪንስፓን ግንባር ቀደም ተወዳዳሪ ሆነው ብቅ ብለዋል። አዲሱ የድርጅቱ መሪ ዓለም አቀፍ ግጭቶችን በመፍታት እና ድርጅቱን በአዲስ መልክ በማደራጀት ረገድ ትልቅ ኃላፊነት ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa bakka bu'aa Antooniyoo Guuteereez bakka bu'uuf qophii kantiibaa haaraa filachuuf hojiin jalqabameera. Maree xiqqaatiin gaggeeffameen Reebekaa Gireenspaan dursaa akka jiran kan ibsame yoo ta'u, dorgomtoonni biroos hedduun jiru. Hogganaan haaraan kun rakkoolee addunyaa hiikuu fi dhaabbaticha sadarkaa sadarkaan haaromsuuf dirqama ulfaataa fudhata.

title: Security camera shows ‘Russian missile’ exploding in Poland
english: A surveillance camera has captured the moment a missile, believed to be Russian, detonated within Polish territory near the Ukrainian border. This incident occurred during a massive aerial offensive launched by Russia against Ukraine. Currently, officials in Poland and NATO are working together to determine the circumstances of this explosion.
amharic: የክትትል ካሜራዎች የሩሲያ ነው ተብሎ የሚጠረጠር ሚሳይል በፖላንድ ድንበር አካባቢ ሲፈነዳ የሚያሳይ ምስል ቀርጸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ጥቃት ወቅት ነው። የፖላንድ ባለስልጣናት እና የኔቶ አባላት ሚሳይሉ እንዴት ወደ ፖላንድ ሊገባ እንደቻለ ለማጣራት ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ነው።
oromo: Kameran nageenyaa misayiliin kan Raashiyaa ta'uun shakkamu tokko daangaa Pooland biratti yeroo dho'u suuraa kaasee jira. Dho'iinsi kun kan mudate yeroo Raashiyaan ukireenirratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa guddaa gaggeessaa turte dha. Amma mootummaan Poolandii fi dhaabbanni naatoo dhimmi kun akkamitti akka mudate qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Father of Georgia Apalachee school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
english: Colin Gray has been sentenced to 15 years in prison for his role in the 2024 Apalachee High School shooting carried out by his son, Colt. The father was convicted of second-degree murder and manslaughter after providing the firearm used in the attack that claimed four lives. This ruling highlights a growing legal trend of holding parents criminally accountable for the violent actions of their children.
amharic: ኮሊን ግሬይ የተባለ አባት ልጁ ኮልት በፈፀመው የ2024ቱ የአፓላቺ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ተኩስ ተጠያቂ በመሆኑ የ15 ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። አባቱ ለአራቱ ሰዎች ሕልፈት ምክንያት የሆነውን የጦር መሳሪያ ለልጁ በመስጠቱ በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ነፍስ ማጥፋት ወንጀል ተፈርዶበታል። ይህ ብይን ወላጆች የልጆቻቸውን የኃይል ድርጊት ተከትሎ በሕግ ፊት ተጠያቂ የሚሆኑበትን አዲስ አዝማሚያ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Abbaan ijoollee, Kolin Girey, bara 2024 mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa Apaalaachii keessatti ilmi isaa Kolt ajjeechaa raawwateef itti gaafatamaa ta'ee argamee waggaa 15 hidhuutti murame. Abbaan kun hidhannoo ilmi isaa namoota afur ittiin ajjeese erga kenneef booda, yakka ajjeechaa itti murameera. Murteen kun warra ijoolleen isaanii yakka raawwatan irratti seeraan itti gaafatamuu akka qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Uefa to boycott World Cups if Fifa plans approved
english: European football associations have vowed to boycott all FIFA tournaments if the governing body proceeds with selling stakes of its competitions to private investors. UEFA strongly opposes treating the World Cup as a commercial product, arguing that it belongs to the global football community rather than private interests. Similarly, the North and Central American football governing body, Concacaf, has rejected the proposal and expressed significant dissatisfaction with FIFA's leadership.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ፊፋ የውድድሮቹን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ የሚያቅድ ከሆነ በሁሉም የፊፋ ውድድሮች ላለመሳተፍ ወስነዋል። ዩኢኤፍኤ (UEFA) የዓለም ዋንጫን እንደ የንግድ ምርት መመልከትን አጥብቆ በመቃወም፣ ውድድሩ የጋራ ቅርስ እንጂ ለግል ኢንቨስትመንት የሚቀርብ አይደለም ብሏል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ የሰሜን እና የመካከለኛው አሜሪካ እግር ኳስ አስተዳደር አካል የሆነው ኮንካካፍም (Concacaf) የፊፋን እቅድ ውድቅ አድርጎ በፊፋ አመራር ላይ ያለውን ቅሬታ ገልጿል።
oromo: Waldaan kubbaa miilaa Awurooppaa, FIFA dorgommiwwansaa qooda fudhattoota dhuunfaaf gurguruuf karoorfate yoo ta’e, dorgommiwwan FIFA hunda keessatti hirmaachuu akka dhaabu ibseera. UEFA, Waancaan Addunyaa meeshaa daldalaa akka hin taaneefi qabeenya uummata kubbaa miilaa addunyaa akka ta'e jala muruun, akkaataa karoora FIFA kanaa balaaleffateera. Haaluma wal fakkaatuun, bulchiinsi kubbaa miilaa Ameerikaa Kaabaafi Giddugaleessaa (Concacaf) karoora FIFA kana kan momeefi hogganoota FIFA irratti amantii akka dhabe ibseera.

title: Palestine Action co-founder wins UK Supreme Court appeal bid
english: Huda Ammori, a co-founder of the activist group Palestine Action, has successfully secured permission to take her legal battle to the UK Supreme Court. She is challenging the British government's official classification of her organization as a terrorist group. The court's decision will now allow her to formally contest this designation in the country's highest judicial body.
amharic: የፍልስጤም አክሽን ቡድን ተባባሪ መስራች የሆኑት ሁዳ አሞሪ፣ የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግስት ቡድናቸውን በአሸባሪነት ለመፈረጅ የወሰደውን ውሳኔ ለመቃወም ወደ ከፍተኛው ፍርድ ቤት ለመቅረብ ፈቃድ አግኝተዋል። የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ይህንኑ ክስ እንዲያዩ መፍቀዱን ተከትሎ፣ የቡድኑ መሪ ውሳኔውን በህግ ለመሞገት መንገድ ተከፍቶላቸዋል።
oromo: Huda Ammorii kan jedhaman, hundeeessituun garee Palestine Action jedhamuu, mootummaan UK garee isaanii akka garee shororkeessitti ramaduu isaatti mormuudhaan mana murtii olaanaa UK-tti himachuu akka danda'an hayyama argataniiru. Murtoon mana murtii olaanaa kun himannaa isaanii gama seeraatiin akka itti fufan isaan dandeessiseera. Amma garuu murtee mootummaan darbe kana qorannoo seeraa gadi fagoo taasisuun falmachuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Pakistan coal mine explosion kills at least 11, traps dozens
english: A methane gas explosion in a coal mine in Pakistan's Balochistan province has killed at least 11 workers. Dozens remain trapped deep underground, prompting an ongoing rescue operation to locate the missing miners. The incident highlights the persistent lack of safety standards and ventilation in the region's mining industry.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ባሉቺስታን ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኝ የድንጋይ ከሰል ማዕድን ውስጥ በተከሰተ የሜቴን ጋዝ ፍንዳታ ቢያንስ 11 ሠራተኞች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በርካታ ሠራተኞች ከምድር በታች ተጠልፈው በመቅረታቸው የነፍስ አድን ስራው ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በማዕድን ማውጫው ዘርፍ ያለውን የደህንነት መጓደል እና የክትትል እጥረት በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Godina Baalochistaan kan Paakistaanitti, bakka keemikaala 'methane' walitti qabamee ture dhoowween lubbuun hojjettootaa 11 darbeera. Hojjettoonni baay'een lafa jalaatti daangeeffamanii waan jiraniif, tattaaffiin isaan baasuuf godhamu itti fufeera. Balaan kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi iddoo hojii keessatti hojjettoonni haala hamaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Saudi Arabia announces maritime defence alliance to secure vital waterways
english: Saudi Arabia has launched a new maritime military coalition with 13 other nations to protect key shipping lanes in the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden, and the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. This alliance aims to secure international trade and energy supplies against rising regional threats, particularly attacks from Houthi fighters. By fostering collective defense, the participating countries hope to keep these critical waterways open and stable during a period of escalating geopolitical tension.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ሌሎች 13 አገራትን በማካተት በቀይ ባህር፣ በአደን ባህረ ሰላጤ እና በባብ አል-ማንዳብ የባህር መስመሮች ላይ የሚደረጉ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመጠበቅ አዲስ የባህር ኃይል ጥምረት መሥርታለች። ይህ ጥምረት በክልሉ የሚስተዋሉ የጸጥታ ስጋቶችን እና በተለይም በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። አገራቱ በጋራ በመተባበር ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ እና የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት መስመሮችን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እና የባህር ላይ ትራፊክን ለማረጋጋት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan biyyoota biraa 13 waliin ta’uun, karaalee bishaan irraa barbaachisoo ta’an kanneen akka Galaana Diimaa, Ganda Aden fi Bab al-Mandeb eeguuf waltajjii waraana galaana haaraa uumteetti. Duulli kun daldala idil-addunyaa fi dhiyeessiin anniisaa akka hin gufanne, keessattuu haleellaa garee Huutii ittisuuf kan gargaaruudha. Biyyoonni hirmaatan kun nageenya galaana irratti waliin hojjechuun, yeroo ammaa kana yaaddoo siyaasaa uumame jiru keessatti karaaleen kunneen nagaa fi tasgabbii qabaachuu akka danda'an yaadamee kan hundaa'eedha.

title: Houthis consider imposing fees for Red Sea passage: Report
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels are reportedly planning to charge fees for ships navigating the Bab el-Mandeb strait. This move follows recent regional escalations, including attacks on tankers and blocked maritime routes involving Iran and Saudi Arabia. The group aims to use this potential levy as leverage to pressure the U.S. government to end its conflict with Iran.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ አማፂያን በባብ ኤል-ማንዴብ የባህር በር የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ክፍያ እንዲከፍሉ ለማድረግ እያሰቡ መሆኑ ተሰምቷል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በኢራን እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ መካከል ባለው ውጥረት እና በተለያዩ የመርከብ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ነው። ቡድኑ ይህንን አዲስ የክፍያ ስርዓት በመጠቀም የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር ያለውን ጦርነት እንዲያቆም ጫና ለመፍጠር አቅዷል።
oromo: Ajajoonni Huutii kan Yaman, dooniiwwan karaa Bab el-Mandeb darban irraa kaffaltii fudhachuuf karoorachaa jiraachuun gabaafameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufu jidduu kana naannichatti walitti buiinsii fi haleellaan dooniiwwan irratti raawwatamaa jiru erga hammaatee booda dha. Gareen kun kaffaltii kana akka meeshaatti fayyadamuun, mootummaan Ameerikaa waraana Iraan waliin taasisu akka dhaabu dhiibbaa gochuuf karoorata.

title: Congo’s Ebola death toll passes 1,500 as it struggles to halt spread
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,500 deaths, with total cases exceeding 3,400. Ongoing violence, a lack of an effective vaccine for this specific virus strain, and community mistrust continue to hinder response efforts. Authorities are particularly concerned as many deaths occur outside of medical facilities, making it difficult to control the rapid spread of the disease.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ከ1,500 በላይ ሰዎችን ሕይወት ቀጥፏል፣ የተያዙት ሰዎች ቁጥርም ከ3,400 በላይ ደርሷል። በክልሉ ባለው ግጭት፣ ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ ተስማሚ የሆነ ክትባት አለመኖር እና በጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ ያለው የመተማመን ችግር የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። አብዛኞቹ ሞቶች በሕክምና ማዕከላት ውጭ እየተከሰቱ መሆናቸው ስጋትን የፈጠረ ሲሆን ይህም ወረርሽኙን በፍጥነት ለመቆጣጠር እንቅፋት ሆኗል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa RD Koongoo keessatti babal'ateen namoonni 1,500 ol du'anii jiru, lakkoofsi namoota vaayrasichaan qabamanii immoo 3,400 irra ga'eera. Naannicha keessatti walitti bu'iinsi jiraachuun, vaayrasichaaf kan ta'u talaaliin gahaa dhabamuu fi uummanni ogeeyyota fayyaa irratti amantaa dhabuun isaa to'annoo dhukkubichaa irratti gufuu guddaa ta'ee jira. Namoonni baay'een hospitaala ala du'aa waan jiraniif, babal'ina vaayrasicha to'achuun akkaataa itti cimaa jiruudha.

title: UN demands end of Ugandan clampdown on dissent
english: The United Nations has criticized the Ugandan government for suppressing political opposition and restricting fundamental civil freedoms. Human rights officials highlighted widespread abuses, including the targeting of journalists, activists, and leaders like Kizza Besigye, following the recent election. UN High Commissioner Volker Turk warned that these actions are fostering a climate of fear and demanded that authorities stop interfering with civil institutions.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የኡጋንዳ መንግስት በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ እየወሰደ ያለውን እርምጃ እና የዜጎችን መሰረታዊ ነፃነት መገደቡን አውግዟል። የሰብአዊ መብት ባለስልጣናት በተለይም ከቅርብ ጊዜ ምርጫ ወዲህ ጋዜጠኞች፣ አክቲቪስቶች እና የተቃዋሚ መሪዎች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን እስራትና በደል አውግዘዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብት ኮሚሽነር ቮልከር ቱርክ፣ መንግስት የፈጠረው የፍርሃት ድባብ የሀገሪቱን ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሂደት እየጎዳው መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ባለስልጣናት በሲቪል ተቋማት ላይ ጣልቃ መግባታቸውን እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa mootummaan Yugaandaa mormitoota siyaasaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiru fi mirgoota bu'uuraa namoomaa daangessaa jiru balaaleffateera. Hojjettoonni mirga namoomaa erga filannoon geggeeffamee as, gaazexeessitoota, qabsaa'otaa fi hogganoota akka Kizza Besigye irratti dararaa fi hidhaan babal'achuu isaa ibsaniiru. Komishinarri mirga namoomaa kan UN, Volker Turk, gochi kun biyyattii keessa sodaafi rifannoo guddaa uumuu isaa eeruun, mootummaan bu'uuraalee sivilii irratti harka galchuu isaa akka dhaabu gaafateera.

title: ABC News says FCC is carrying out intimidation campaign to shape coverage
english: ABC News has accused the Federal Communications Commission of threatening to revoke broadcast licenses to intimidate the network for its critical coverage of President Trump. The company claims the FCC's unprecedented early review of its stations is a retaliatory tactic designed to force media outlets to align with the administration's views. Press freedom advocates warn that this pressure, combined with other lawsuits against major news organizations, poses a significant threat to independent journalism in the United States.
amharic: ኤቢሲ ኒውስ የፌዴራል ኮሙኒኬሽን ኮሚሽን (FCC) ስለ ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የሚዘግቡትን ወሳኝ መረጃዎች ለመቆጣጠር የሥርጭት ፈቃዳቸውን በመሰረዝ እንደሚያስፈራራ ከሰሰ። ኩባንያው ኤጀንሲው የቲቪ ጣቢያዎቹን ፈቃድ ያለጊዜው እንዲገመገም ማድረጉ መገናኛ ብዙኃን ከመንግሥት አቋም ጋር እንዲጣጣሙ ለማስገደድ የሚደረግ የበቀል እርምጃ ነው ብሏል። የፕሬስ ነፃነት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ድርጊት እና ሌሎች በመገናኛ ብዙኃን ላይ የሚወሰዱ የክስ እርምጃዎች በአሜሪካ የጋዜጠኝነት ነፃነት ላይ ትልቅ ስጋት እየፈጠሩ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: ABC News komishinii quunnamtii federaalaa (FCC) gabaasa isaa kan dura bu'aa Trump irratti xiyyeeffatuu fi ceephatuu ittisuuf hayyama tamsaasaa haquun doorsisaa jira jechuun himateera. Kampaniin kun akka jedhutti, FCC'n qorannoo hayyamaa dursee gaggeessuun isaa miidiyaaleen akka fedhii mootummaatti gabaasa akka dhiheessan dirqisiisuuf yaalamee kan argamee fi tarkaanfii haaloo bahuudha. Hayyoonni mirga miidiyaafi bilisummaa yaadaa akka jedhanitti, dhiibbaan kun fi himannaan miidiyaalee gurguddaa irratti baname, bilisummaa gabaasaa fi dimokiraasii biyyattii irratti balaa cimaa kan fiduudha.

title: Spain’s Ceuta declares emergency over surge in migrant arrivals
english: Spain has officially declared a state of emergency in its North African enclave of Ceuta following a massive influx of migrants. Over 1,500 people have crossed into the territory by sea recently, with many traveling by swimming or using inflatable gear. Local shelters are currently struggling to manage the sudden increase in arrivals, prompting officials to request urgent support.
amharic: ስፔን በሰሜን አፍሪካ ግዛቷ ሴውታ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ስደተኞች በመግባታቸው አስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ማወጇን አስታውቃለች። ባለፈው አንድ ሳምንት ብቻ ከ1,500 በላይ የሚሆኑ ስደተኞች በባህር በኩል ወደ ግዛቷ የገቡ ሲሆን፣ አብዛኞቹ በመዋኘት እና በተለያዩ ተንሳፋፊ መሳሪያዎች ተጠቅመው ነው የመጡት። በአካባቢው የሚገኙ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች በብዛት መጨናነቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የከተማዋ አስተዳደር አስቸኳይ እርዳታ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Ispeen naannoo ishee Kaaba Afrikaa kan taate Seewutaatti godaantotni lakkoofsaan hedduu ta'an erga seenanii booda labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsiteetti. Torban darbe keessa namoonni 1,500 ol ta'an karaa garbaatiin gara naannichaa kan galan yoo ta'u, baay'een isaanii daakuudhaan ykn meeshaalee bishaan irra boqotan fayyadamuun seenaniiru. Bakkeewwan godaantotni itti qubatan guutummaatti guutamuun isaa rakkoo waan uumeef, bulchiinsi naannichaa gargaarsa ariifachiisaa gaafateera.

title: Turtle rescued from rubble a month after Venezuela earthquake
english: A turtle named Pascualina miraculously survived for over a month trapped under the debris of a building that collapsed during an earthquake in Venezuela. The animal had fallen from the sixth floor during the disaster but was eventually discovered alive. She has since been safely returned to her relieved owners.
amharic: ፓስኩዋሊና የተባለች ኤሊ በቬኔዝዌላ በተከሰተ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምክንያት የፈራረሰ ህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ስር ከአንድ ወር በላይ በህይወት መቆየቷ ተነግሯል። አደጋው ሲከሰት ከስድስተኛ ፎቅ ወደ ታች የወደቀችው ኤሊዋ፣ በተአምር በህይወት ተገኝታ ባለቤቶቿ ጋር ተገናኝታለች።
oromo: Qocaan Paaskaalinaa jedhamtu tokko, biyya Veeneezuweelaatti erga lafti socho'ee booda, diigama mana jigaa jala guyyaa soddomii ol lubbuun turuu ishee himameera. Qocaanni kun yeroo balaan kun mudatu gubbaa mana ba'ii ja'affaa irraa kufuus, diigama jala baatee maatii isheetiin wal taateetti.

title: Egypt says it has energy alternatives after drone attack on Damietta gas vessel
english: Following a drone strike that harmed a natural gas ship at the Damietta port, the Egyptian government confirmed it has successfully found other sources to meet its energy requirements. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly noted that officials are still probing the incident, which has not yet been linked to any specific group. Authorities are working to ensure energy supplies remain stable despite the recent disruption.
amharic: በደሚያታ ወደብ ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት የጋዝ መርከብ ጉዳት ከደረሰ በኋላ፣ የግብፅ መንግስት የኃይል ፍላጎቱን ለማሟላት አማራጭ መፍትሄዎችን ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሙስጠፋ ማድቡሊ እስካሁን ለጥቃቱ ሃላፊነት የወሰደ አካል እንደሌለ ገልፀው፣ ምርመራውም በመካሄድ ላይ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል። መንግስት በደረሰው ጉዳት የሃይል አቅርቦቱ እንዳይስተጓጎል እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Buufata Damietta irratti miidhaan markaba gaazii irra ga’een booda, mootummaan Misir fedhii anniisaa isaa guuttachuuf filannoo biraa akka qabu ibseera. Muummichi ministeeraa Mustafaa Maadbuulii, hanga ammaa namni ykn gareen miidhaa kanaaf itti gaafatamummaa fudhate akka hin jirreefi qorannoon itti fufuusaa himaniiru. Mootummaan miidhaan sun haala dhiyeessii anniisaa irratti dhiibbaa akka hin geessisneef hojjachaa jira.

title: Israeli forces injure Palestinian man near Nablus
english: A 59-year-old Palestinian man was shot and wounded by Israeli forces near Nablus in the occupied West Bank on Thursday evening. The victim was struck in the neck while driving his vehicle in the town of Beita. Medical teams provided emergency care at the scene before transferring him to a local hospital for further treatment.
amharic: ሐሙስ ምሽት በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው ቤይታ ከተማ የ59 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለው ፍልስጤማዊ በታጠቁ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በጥይት ተመታ። ሰውየው መኪና እየነዳ ሳለ በደረሰበት የተኩስ ጥቃት አንገቱ ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የድንገተኛ አምቡላንስ ሠራተኞች የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ካደረጉለት በኋላ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስዶ ህክምናውን እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa galgala naannoo Naablusitti, magaalaa Beeyitaa jedhamtu keessatti namni Falasxiin tokko kan umriin isaa 59 ta'e humnoota Israa'eliin rasaasaan rukutame. Namtichi kun konkolaataa isaa oofaa osoo jiruu rasaasa irratti dhukaafameen mormaa isaa irratti miidhaan irra ga'eera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa iddoo sana ga'uun wal-yaalii jalqabaa erga godhaniin booda, gara mana yaalaatti geeffamee yaalamaa jira.

title: Saudi Arabia unveils plans for multinational maritime defence coalition
english: Saudi Arabia is organizing an international maritime coalition to secure shipping routes in the Red Sea following ongoing attacks by Houthi rebels. The initiative aims to protect global trade and energy supplies by establishing a central headquarters and collaborative defense efforts in the region. While many countries have expressed support for the plan, some nations, including Oman and the UAE, did not join the initial joint statement.

oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan haleellaa garee Huutii hordofee karaa bishaanii galaana diimaa keessa jiru eeguuf waldaa humna galaana idil-addunyaa hundeeffachuuf karoorfattetti. Karoorri kun daldala idil-addunyaa fi dhiyeessii anniisaa miidhaa irraa ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha. Biyyoonni hedduun deeggarsa isaanii ibsanis, biyyoonni akka Omaan fi UAE garuu ibsa waliinii kana irratti hirmaachuu hin dandeenye.

title: Iran says its army struck US assets at Bahrain’s Sheikh Isa base
english: Iranian state media claims its military conducted an operation targeting American facilities at the Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain. This specific base is a strategic site for the United States Navy's Fifth Fleet and has frequently been targeted during recent conflicts. However, officials from both the United States and Bahrain have yet to verify that this attack actually occurred.
amharic: የኢራን የመንግስት ሚዲያ በባህሬን በሚገኘው የሼክ ኢሳ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። ይህ ጣቢያ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል አምስተኛ መርከቦች የሚጠቀሙበት ወሳኝ ስፍራ ሲሆን በተደጋጋሚ የጥቃት ኢላማ ሆኖ ቆይቷል። ይሁን እንጂ የአሜሪካ እና የባህሬን ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ መፈጸሙን እስካሁን አላረጋገጡም።
oromo: Miidiyaan mootummaa Iraan buufata xiyyaraa Sheikh Isa kan Baahireyn keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa ibseera. Buufatni kun humna galaana Ameerikaa kan 'Fifth Fleet' fayyadamuuf bakka murteessaa yoo ta'u, yeroo ammaa haleellaa irra deddeebi'amee raawwatamu irratti argama. Ta'us, hoggantoonni Ameerikaa fi Baahireyn haleellaan kun dhuguma raawwatamuu isaa hanga ammaatti hin mirkaneessine.

title: Houthis consider imposing fees for Red Sea passage: Report
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels are reportedly planning to charge fees for ships navigating the Red Sea's Bab el-Mandeb strait. This move, which follows recent attacks on Saudi vessels, is seen as an attempt to exert pressure on the U.S. government regarding its ongoing conflict with Iran. While some nations like China are seeking exemptions, international naval forces currently lack the capacity to fully secure the route, complicating global maritime trade.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን በቀይ ባህር ባብ ኤል-ማንደብ መተላለፊያ ለሚያልፉ መርከቦች ክፍያ ለመጠየቅ እያሰቡ መሆኑ ተዘግቧል። ይህ እርምጃ በሳውዲ መርከቦች ላይ ከተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ጋር ተያይዞ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር እያደረገች ላለው ጦርነት ተጽዕኖ ለመፍጠር የታለመ ነው ተብሏል። አንዳንድ አገራት እንደ ቻይና ከክፍያው ነጻ ለመሆን እየደራደሩ ቢሆንም፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ኃይሎች የንግድ መስመሩን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመቆጣጠር አቅም ማጣታቸው የዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን ስጋት ውስጥ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Humni hootii kan Yaman galaana diimaa keessa kan darban dooniiwwan irratti kaffaltii murteessuuf karoorfachaa jiraachuu gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun miidhaa dooniiwwan Saudii irratti raawwatame hordofee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa mootummaa Ameerikaa irratti uumuuf kan karoorfame fakkaata. Akkuma Chaayinaa biyyoonni tokko tokko kaffaltii malee darbuuf mari'achaa jiranis, humnoonni waraana galaana addunyaa karaa kana guutummaatti eeguuf dandeettii dhabuun isaanii adeemsa daldalaa addunyaa irratti rakkoo uumaa jira.

title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
english: Iran's recent missile attack on a US base suggests a strategic shift toward limited confrontation rather than total war or peace. Both nations are avoiding a full-scale conflict to prevent economic collapse and regional instability. By keeping the situation volatile, Iran aims to maintain leverage over global energy markets and shipping routes while resisting ongoing sanctions.
amharic: ኢራን በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ ጣቢያ ላይ ያደረሰችው የሮኬት ጥቃት፣ አገሪቱ ከሁለንተናዊ ጦርነት ወይም ከሰላም ይልቅ ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት ውሱን ግጭትን እንደምትመርጥ ያሳያል። ሁለቱም አገራት ከባድ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስን እና ቀጣናዊ አለመረጋጋትን ለመከላከል ሲሉ ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ከመግባት ይቆጠባሉ። ኢራን ይህን ውጥረት በመጠቀም በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ እና በባህር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ተጽዕኖዋን ለማስቀጠል እና ማዕቀቦችን ለመቋቋም እየሞከረች ነው።
oromo: Iraan dhiheenya kana buufata waraana Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa rookeettii raawwachuun ishee, biyyattiin waraana guutuu ykn nagaa buusuu mannaa, walitti bu'iinsa daangeeffame akka filattu kan agarsiisuudha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu kisaaraa dinagdee guddaa fi tasgabbii dhabuu naannawaa sanaa ittisuuf jecha waraana guutuu irraa of qusachaa jiru. Iraan walitti bu'iinsa kana fayyadamtee gabaa annisaa fi daandiiwwan geejjiba galaanaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, akkasumas kaffaltii diinagdee ishee irratti jiru mormuuf karoorfachaa jirti.

title: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
english: In the past week, a large number of migrants have entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta by swimming from Morocco or crossing border fences. Local officials report that this surge has overwhelmed regional facilities and created a humanitarian emergency. The Spanish government is planning to visit the territory to address the security situation and the strain on resources for minors.

oromo: Torban darbe keessa baay'inni godaantotaa Morokoo irraa gara daangaa Ispeen, Si'uutaa (Ceuta) jedhamutti daakuudhaan ykn daangaa qaxxaamuruudhaan galaniiru. Qondaalonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, namoonni baay'inaan seenuun kun bakka qubataafi tajaajila adda addaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun rakkoo namoomaa guddaa fideera. Mootummaan Ispeen haala nageenyaafi rakkoo mudate kana ilaalchisee tarkaanfii fudhachuuf gara naannichaa deemuf karoorfateera.

title: Rights report reconstructs fatal shooting of Palestinian man
english: A human rights organization called Al-Haq has released a detailed investigation into the killing of Awdeh al-Hathaleen, a Palestinian man shot one year ago. Using video evidence, forensics, and spatial mapping, the report identifies an Israeli settler named Yinon Levy as the person responsible for the shooting. The findings emphasize that the victim was unarmed and did not present any danger at the time of his death.

Ragaalee viidiyoo, qorannoo saayinsii fi kaartaa fayyadamuun, gabaasichi ajjeechaa kana kan raawwate Yinoon Levii jedhamu kan ta’e qubata Israa’el akka ta’e beeksiseera. title: ‘To play God’: Cuba’s healthcare system collapses under US pressure
english: Cuba’s healthcare system is facing a severe crisis as intensified United States sanctions and a fuel blockade have led to critical shortages of medical supplies and electricity. Doctors report a heartbreaking rise in mortality rates, particularly among newborns, due to poor hygiene and a lack of essential medications. The political tension between the two nations is severely undermining the country's public health services, which were once a source of national pride.

title: In Their Own Hands: Ghana’s Drug Vigilantes
english: In Ghana, an escalating crisis involving synthetic opioid addiction has led local residents in Tamale to form volunteer task forces. These groups are patrolling streets and punishing drug dealers and users directly because they believe the government has failed to act. While some officials support these efforts, critics argue that such vigilante justice poses significant risks and cannot replace official law enforcement.
amharic: በጋና እየተባባሰ የመጣው ሰው ሰራሽ አደንዛዥ ዕፅ ሱሰኝነት በታማሌ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ተቃውሞ በማስነሳቱ በራሳቸው የተደራጁ የፀጥታ ቡድኖች እንዲቋቋሙ አድርጓል። እነዚህ ቡድኖች መንግስት ችግሩን ለመቅረፍ በቂ እርምጃ እየወሰደ አይደለም በሚል እሳቤ፣ የራሳቸውን ህግ በመተግበር አዘዋዋሪዎችን እና ሱሰኞችን እየቀጡ ይገኛሉ። አንዳንዶች ይህንን ተግባር የሚደግፉ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሙያዎች ግን የህግ የበላይነትን በግለሰቦች እጅ መጣሉ አደገኛ እንደሆነ ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Gaanaa keessatti babal'achuu qoricha sammuu hadoochuun walqabatee, jiraattonni magaalaa Taamaalee tarkaanfii mataa isaanii fudhachuuf garee fedhii irratti hundaaye ijaarataniiru. Gareen kun mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf gahaa miti jedhanii waan amannaniif, gurguddootaa fi fayyadamtoota qorichichaa irratti ofumaan seera kabachiisuuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Mootummaan qaama tokko tokko garee kana deeggaraa kan jiru yoo tahu, gareen biraa garuu seera of harka galchuun kun balaa guddaa akka qabu fi bakka seera mootummaa hin bu'u jedhanii akeekkachiisu.

title: NATO jets scramble as Russian missile detonates in Poland
english: A Russian missile launched during an attack on Ukraine strayed into Polish territory and exploded, prompting NATO to deploy fighter jets for defense. While the incident caused no casualties in Poland, it has increased regional fears that the ongoing war could spill over into neighboring countries. Both Polish and NATO officials have condemned the event as a dangerous and reckless provocation by Russia.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ የከፈተችው የጥቃት አካል የሆነ የሚሳይል ጥቃት የፖላንድን ድንበር ጥሶ በመግባቱ የኔቶ አየር ኃይል ተዋጊ ጄቶችን አሰማርቷል። በፖላንድ በኩል ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ባያጋጥምም፣ ክስተቱ ጦርነቱ ወደ ጎረቤት አገራት ሊዛመት ይችላል የሚለውን ስጋት ከፍ አድርጎታል። የፖላንድ እና የኔቶ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የሩሲያ ድርጊት አደገኛ እና ሀላፊነት የጎደለው ድርጊት ሲሉ አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Rusiyan haleellaa Yukreen irratti raawwatte keessaa misayiliin tokko daangaa Poolaand ce'ee kufuun isaa, mootummaan Poolaand fi NATO xiyyara waraanaa akka sochoosan dirqisiiseera. Poolaand keessatti namni miidhame hin jiruus, gochi kun waraanni kun gara biyyoota ollaa akka babal'achuu danda'u sodaa guddaa uumeera. Hogganoonni Poolaand fi NATO tarkaanfii Rusiyaan fudhatte kana gocha balaa fi of-eeggannoo hin qabne jechuun balaaleeffataniiru.

title: IRGC video of retaliatory strikes on US targets in Jordan
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has shared footage purportedly showing missile strikes against American aircraft at an air base in Jordan. Iran claims this military action was a response to previous US attacks on Qeshm Island that resulted in three fatalities. This incident highlights rising tensions between the two nations following the deadly strikes.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአል አዝራቅ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ሚሳኤል ማውረዱን የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርጓል። ኢራን ይህ እርምጃ በቃሽም ደሴት ላይ ሶስት ሰዎችን የገደለው የአሜሪካ ጥቃት አጸፋ መሆኑን ገልጻለች። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humnoonni Eegumsa Kutaawwan Kilaa'ulaa (IRGC) kan Iiraan, buufata xiyyaaraa Yordaanos keessatti argamu Al-Azraaq irratti xiyyaara Ameerikaa garaa xiyyaaraan haleeluu isaanii agarsiisuu ragaa viidiyoo gadi lakkisaniiru. Iiraan haleellaan kun, Ameerikaan odola Qeshm irratti weerara raawwattee namoota sadii ajjeesteef haaloo ba'uuf kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsiteetti. Taateen kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru kan dhiphiseedha.

title: US GDP growth dips as inflation and trade deficits pressure economy
english: The U.S. economy experienced a slowdown in the second quarter of 2026, with GDP growth dropping to 1.5 percent from 2.1 percent earlier in the year. This decline is largely attributed to a widening trade deficit and rising fuel costs, which continue to strain consumer finances. While technology investments and consumer spending provided some support, persistent inflation remains a significant challenge for the national economy.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ በ2026 ሁለተኛ ሩብ ዓመት ላይ የዕድገት መቀዛቀዝ አሳይቷል፣ ይህም ከዓመቱ መጀመሪያ የነበረውን 2.1 በመቶ ወደ 1.5 በመቶ ዝቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ መቀነስ በዋናነት የተከሰተው የንግድ ልውውጥ ጉድለት በመስፋፋቱ እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ በመጨመሩ ምክንያት የሸማቾችን ጫና በመጨመሩ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የቴክኖሎጂ ኢንቨስትመንቶች እና የሸማቾች ወጪ የተወሰነ ድጋፍ ቢሰጡም፣ ግሽበት በሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dinagdeen Yunaayitid Isteetes waggaa 2026 keessatti, ji'oota darbanii keessa guddina gadi bu'aa galmeessiseera; kunis guddina kanaan dura ture kan %2.1 ture gara %1.5 tti gad buuseera. Gadi bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe hanqina daldalaa guddachuu fi gatiin boba'aa dabaluun baasii ummataa irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeefid. Invastimantiin teknolojiin fi baasiin gurgurtaa guddina dinagdeetiif deeggarsa ta'us, gatiin meeshaalee fi tajaajilaa dabaluun (inflation) rakkoo guddaa dinagdee biyyattii ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: Iran’s foreign minister presses European counterparts over bases used in US operations
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has warned Bulgaria and Cyprus against allowing their territories to host US military aircraft for operations against Iran. He argued that providing such support facilitates aggression and damages diplomatic ties. Tehran has further cautioned that nations permitting the use of their bases for American military actions may encounter negative repercussions.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ቡልጋሪያ እና ሳይፕረስ የአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በግዛታቸው እንዲሰፍሩ መፍቀዳቸው ስህተት መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ድጋፍ በኢራን ላይ የሚፈጸም ጥቃት አካል መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ሀገራቱ ለዚህ ተግባር መሰረተ ልማታቸውን ካመቻቹ የሚያስከትለው መዘዝ እንደሚኖር ገልጸዋል። አራግቺ ይህ አካሄድ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ወዳጅነት የሚጎዳ መሆኑንም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchiin, biyyoonni Bulgaariyaa fi Saayippires xiyyaara waraanaa Ameerikaa buufata isaanii akka fayyadamaniif heyyamuu isaanii akka balaaleffatan ibsan. Iraan akka jetteetti, biyyoonni buufata isaanii Ameerikaaf yoo kennan, kun weerara Iraan irratti gaggeeffamu akka deggaruutti fudhatama. Kanaafuu, biyyoonni kun gocha kana irraa of qusachuu akka qaban, yoo ta’uu baate garuu tarkaanfii irraa fudhatamuufi akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Chaos at London court as over 1,500 Palestine Action cases listed in one day
english: London's legal system faced significant disruption as over 1,500 individuals linked to Palestine Action protests were incorrectly summoned to Westminster Crown Court. Despite previous notifications that their hearings had been delayed until October, court records listed these cases for a single day, leading to widespread confusion and contradictory instructions for defendants. Critics describe this administrative breakdown as evidence of a struggling judicial system as the Supreme Court simultaneously reviews the legality of the government's ban on the activist group.
amharic: ከፓለስታይን አክሽን ተቃውሞ ጋር በተያያዘ ከ1,500 በላይ ሰዎች የሽብር ክስ የቀረበባቸው ሲሆን፣ በለንደን ፍርድ ቤት በተፈጠረ የቢሮክራሲ ስህተት ከፍተኛ ውዥንብር ተፈጥሯል። ቀደም ሲል ቀጠሮአቸው ወደ ጥቅምት ወር መተላለፉ ተነግሮአቸው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በስህተት ሁሉም በአንድ ቀን እንዲቀርቡ በመደረጉ ተከሳሾች ግራ ተጋብተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በፍትህ ስርዓቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ መዘበራረቅ መፈጠሩን ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱም ቡድኑ ላይ የተጣለውን እገዳ ህጋዊነት እየመረመረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Namoonni 1,500 ol ta'an kanneen duula Palestine Action waliin walqabatee himannaan shororkummaa irratti baname, manni murtii Landan keessatti wal-dhaba guddaa uumaniiru. Qabxiiwwan himannaa isaanii gara ji'a Onkololeessaatti dabarfamee osoo jiruu, dogoggora bulchiinsaatiin hundi isaanii guyyaa tokkotti akka dhiyaatan waamamuun isaanii namoota hedduu burjaajesseera. Rakkoon kun sirni haqaa biyyattii keessatti quubsa kan hin qabne ta'uu kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, manni murtii olaanoon immoo dhorkaa garee kana irratti fudhatamee ture irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: US military says no aircraft hit in attempted Iranian attacks
english: The United States military has officially denied claims made by Iran's Revolutionary Guard regarding the destruction of several American fighter jets. Officials stated that none of their aircraft sustained damage or were lost during recent hostile activities. Furthermore, the U.S. Central Command dismissed reports that a commercial ship had successfully bypassed their blockade of Iranian ports.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘብ በበርካታ የአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰናል በሚል ያቀረበውን ውንጀላ አስተባብሏል። ምንም ዓይነት የአሜሪካ አውሮፕላን በቅርቡ በተፈጠሩ ግጭቶች እንዳልወደመ ወይም እንዳልተጎዳ አስታውቋል። በተጨማሪም የአሜሪካ ሴንትራል ኮማንድ አንድ የንግድ መርከብ በአሜሪካ የታገዱ የኢራን ወደቦችን ጥሶ ገብቷል የሚለውን ዘገባ ውድቅ አድርጓል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa himata gareen 'Revolutionary Guard' kan Iraan xiyyaarota waraana Ameerikaa miidheera jechuun dhiyeesse guutummaatti haaleera. Humni waraana Ameerikaa akka ibsetti, haleellaa dhiyeenya kana mudateen xiyyaarotni isaanii tokkollee hin miidhamne ykn hin barbadoofne. Kana malees, qondaaltotni waraana Ameerikaa markabni daldalaa tokko daangaa Ameerikaan buufatawwan Iraan irratti kaa'e cabsee darbeera kan jedhu gabaasichi soba ta'uu beeksisaniiru.

title: Supreme Court will allow appeal hearing over Palestine Action ban
english: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear an appeal from Palestine Action's co-founder regarding the government's decision to label the organization a terrorist group. While a previous court ruling supported the ban as a necessary step for national security, Huda Ammori continues to fight this classification. This upcoming hearing will determine if the restriction on the group's activities remains legally justified.
amharic: የፓለስቲን አክሽን መስራች የቡድኑን በአሸባሪነት የመፈረጅ ውሳኔ በመቃወም ለጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ይግባኝ አቅርበዋል። መንግስት በሀገር ደህንነት ስም የወሰደውን ይህን እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ ፍርድ ቤቶች ተቀብለውት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ መስራቿ ሁዳ አሞሪ ክርክሯን ቀጥላለች። አሁን ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱ ጉዳዩን ለመስማት በመስማማቱ፣ የእግዱ ህጋዊነት በድጋሚ ይታያል።
oromo: Hundeeessaan garee 'Palestine Action' mootummaan garee isaanii akka garee shororkeessitti ramaduu isaatti mormii dhiyeessuun gara mana murtii olaanaatti ol iyyannoo galfateera. Mootummaan nageenya biyyaa eeguuf jecha dhorkaa kana kaa'e yoo ta'u, mana murtiiwwan duraan turanis murtii kana deggeranii turan. Amma mana murtii olaanaatti dhimmi kun irra deebi'amee akka ilaalamuuf murtaa'eera.

title: Supreme Court will allow appeal hearing over Palestine Action ban
english: The UK Supreme Court has agreed to hear an appeal from Huda Ammori, the co-founder of the group Palestine Action, regarding its classification as a terrorist organization. The government banned the group last year, leading to thousands of arrests and criminal charges for supporters. This legal challenge seeks to overturn the ban, which the activists argue unfairly restricts freedom of speech and the right to protest.

title: Three children among eight dead in Russian strikes on Ukraine, officials say
english: A massive Russian overnight missile and drone attack across Ukraine has resulted in the deaths of eight people, including three children. The strikes caused significant destruction to homes and infrastructure, particularly near Kryvyi Rih, while also leading to reports of a stray missile entering Polish territory. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky highlighted the severity of the bombardment following his recent diplomatic efforts to secure advanced defensive equipment from the United States.

Gama biraatiin, mitsi'eliin tokko daangaa Poorlaand cabsee seenuun gabaasameera; pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenskiis biyyi isaanii meeshaalee ittisaa ammayyaa Ameerikaarraa argachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu cimsee dubbateera.

title: Police arrest dozens at London rally supporting Palestine Action
english: British police detained a large number of protesters who gathered outside a London courthouse to demonstrate support for the group Palestine Action. The rally was organized by activists who argue that the government's recent decision to label the group a terrorist organization threatens civil liberties. This event serves as the first major test regarding public assembly for Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s new administration.

Kuniis bulchiinsa haaraa muummicha ministeeraa Andy Burnham jalatti hiriira mormii uummataa mudate isa jalqabaa dha.

title: El Salvador sentences gang members to 1,000 years in prison
english: El Salvador has issued massive prison sentences totaling over 1,000 years to several gang members. These harsh penalties are a result of a major security operation launched by President Nayib Bukele in 2022. The campaign aims to dismantle gang influence within the country through a strict crackdown.

oromo: El Salvador miseensota garee yakkaatiif hidhaa waggaa 1,000 ol ta'u murteessiteetti. Adabbiin cimaan kun kan dhufte erga Pirezidaanti Naayib Buukeelen bara 2022 doorsisa garee yakkaatiin walqabatee tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu eegalanii booda. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti dhiibbaa garee yakkaa kanaa hir'isuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: ‘Go back to your own country’: NZ foreign minister faces backlash
english: New Zealand’s Foreign Minister, Winston Peters, is receiving widespread criticism for telling a Chinese-born lawmaker to return to their home country during a legislative session. This racially charged comment has sparked significant outrage within New Zealand. Additionally, the Chinese government has officially requested that New Zealand officials refrain from involving Beijing in their local political arguments.

title: Islamabad residents rally in solidarity with Kashmir protests
english: Residents of Islamabad recently organized a protest to show their support for demonstrators in Pakistan-administered Kashmir. This gathering follows a period of fatal unrest linked to upcoming regional elections. The next round of voting for the area is expected to take place on August 2.

title: Sudan’s RSF vows to return to Khartoum
english: Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, the leader of Sudan's Rapid Support Forces, has issued a video command for his troops to capture the capital city, Khartoum. This announcement coincides with the intensification of military conflict in North Kordofan and a worsening humanitarian situation across the country. These developments highlight the ongoing instability and the escalating violence between rival factions in Sudan.

Tarkaanfiiwwan kun walitti bu'iinsi biyyattii keessatti jiru fi tasgabbii dhabuun daran hamachaa akka jiru agarsiisu.

title: England appoint Root and Fleming as Test cricket captain and coach
english: England has appointed Joe Root as their new Test cricket captain and Stephen Fleming as the head coach. Root returns to the leadership role following the retirement of Ben Stokes, while Fleming takes over from Brendon McCullum to help improve the team's performance. The pair will officially begin their partnership following an upcoming home series against Pakistan.

title: How does a safe zone in Lebanon become a target three times?
english: The article examines the ongoing conflict in Lebanon, specifically questioning why areas previously designated as safe zones have been repeatedly struck by Israeli military forces. It highlights the vulnerability of these locations and the uncertainty regarding civilian protection amidst escalating violence. The report aims to analyze the strategic and humanitarian implications of these repeated attacks on areas meant to be secure.

title: Israeli strikes kill at least four, including children, across Gaza Strip
english: Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip have killed at least four people, including two children, despite an ongoing ceasefire agreement. These attacks hit civilian areas such as Khan Younis, Bureij refugee camp, and Gaza City, causing further displacement and injuries to dozens of people. The violence occurred while Hamas representatives were in Cairo meeting with international mediators to discuss the implementation of a long-term truce.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ እየተካሄደ ባለው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ቢሆንም፣ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን ከነዚህም መካከል ህጻናት ይገኙበታል። ጥቃቶቹ በካን ዩኒስ፣ በቡሬጅ የስደተኞች ካምፕ እና በጋዛ ከተማ በመፈጸማቸው በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል እንዲሁም ብዙዎች መኖሪያቸውን አጥተዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የሃማስ ተወካዮች የረዥም ጊዜ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን ለመወያየት በካይሮ ከሽምግልና አካላት ጋር በመነጋገር ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Gaza keessatti waldhabdee waraana dhaabuu irratti waliigalteen jiraatus, haleellaa qilleensa irraa Israa'el raawwatteef namoonni afur du'aniiru; isaan keessaas ijoolleen jiru. Haleellaan kunneen magaala Khan Younis, buufata baqattoota Bureij fi magaala Gaza keessatti raawwatamuu isaatiin namoonni hedduun madaa'anii fi qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame bakka buutonni Hamas waliigaltee nageenyaa irratti mari'achuuf biyyoota giddugaleessa ta'an wajjin magaala Kaayiroo keessatti walga'ii gaggeessaa jiranitti.

title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
english: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that a missile which crashed into a field in eastern Poland was likely launched by Russia during a major attack on Ukraine. Although the impact created a large crater, no injuries were reported because it landed in an unpopulated area. Polish officials are currently conducting a detailed investigation to confirm the exact origin and type of the weapon involved.
amharic: የፖላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዶናልድ ቱስክ በምስራቅ ፖላንድ ሜዳ ላይ የወደቀው ሚሳኤል በዩክሬን ላይ በተሰነዘረው ጥቃት ወቅት በሩሲያ የተተኮሰ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። ሚሳኤሉ ትልቅ ጉድጓድ ቢፈጥርም፣ ሰው በማይኖርበት አካባቢ በመውደቁ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም። የፖላንድ ባለስልጣናት የጦር መሳሪያውን አይነት እና አመጣጥ ለማረጋገጥ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Pooland Donald Tusk akka jedhanitti, misayiliin gara baha Poolanditti kufuun boolla guddaa uume, haleellaa Raashiyaan gara Yukireenitti gaggeessite keessatti kan harca'e ta'uu mala jedhamee shakkama. Miidhaan qaamaa namoota irra hin ga'in malee, miidhaan qabeenyaa fi lafaa uumamee jira. Abbootiin taayitaa Pooland misayilichi eenyuun akka hojjetamee fi akkamitti akka achi ga'e mirkaneeffachuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Thousands evacuated in Crete as European wildfires continue to rage
english: Severe wildfires in Crete have forced the evacuation of approximately 8,000 residents and tourists due to intense winds and uncontrollable flames. The fires have already caused tragic loss of life, including three firefighters, and have destroyed homes and farmland across the region. Authorities are struggling to contain the blaze, as extreme weather conditions continue to threaten parts of Greece and neighboring countries.
amharic: በግሪክ የቀርጤስ ደሴት ላይ በተከሰተው የጫካ እሳት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የነፋስ ኃይልና የእሳቱ መስፋፋት 8,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎችና ቱሪስቶች እንዲለቁ ተደርገዋል። ይህ አሰቃቂ አደጋ የሶስት የእሳት አደጋ ተከላካዮችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ቤቶችና የእርሻ መሬቶች እንዲወድሙ አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ቢሞክሩም፣ እየተባባሰ የመጣው የአየር ንብረት ሁኔታ የነፍስ አድን ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Giriin bosonaa ganda Kiriteetti mudateen walqabatee, qilleensi cimaafi ibidni to’annoo ala ta’e namoota kuma saddeet ga’an iddoo isaanii gadhiisisee baasuun dirqama ta’eera. Ibidni kun lubbuu namoota saddeet, keessattuu kanneen ibidda dhaabuuf hojjataa turan sadii galaafatee, manneen jireenyaafi lafa qonnaa hedduus barbadeesseera. Bulchiinsi biyyattii ibidda kana dhaabuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa yoo jiranis, haalli qilleensaa hamaa ta’e hojii kana gufachiisaa jira.

title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
english: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega has proposed a constitutional reform to extend the presidential term by an additional year. This move is part of broader changes that aim to legally prevent political opponents labeled as traitors from participating in future elections. Ortega, who has been in power since 2007, has consistently consolidated his authority by removing term limits and positioning his wife as co-president.
amharic: የኒካራጓው ፕሬዚዳንት ዳንኤል ኦርቴጋ የፕሬዚዳንታዊ የስልጣን ዘመንን በአንድ ዓመት ለማራዘም የሚያስችል የሕገ መንግሥት ማሻሻያ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ መንግሥት እንደ ከሃዲ የሚቆጥራቸውን ተቃዋሚዎች ከምርጫ ውድድር ለማገድ ያለመ ነው። ከ2007 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ስልጣን ላይ ያሉት ኦርቴጋ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የፕሬዚዳንትነት የስልጣን ዘመን ገደቦችን በማንሳት እና ሚስታቸውን በምክትል ፕሬዚዳንትነት በመሰየም ስልጣናቸውን እያጠናከሩ መጥተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Niikaaraaguwaa Daani'eel Oortegaa yeroo turtiisaanii kan pireezidaantummaa waggaa tokkoon dheeressuuf fooyya'iinsa seera bu'uuraa dhiyeessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mormitoota mootummaan akka gadootutti ilaalu fuulduratti hirmaannaa filannoo irraa dhowwuuf kan gargaaruudha. Oortegaa bara 2007 irraa eegalee aangoorra jiran, yeroo turtiirratti daangaa ka’e kaasuudhaan akkasumas haati warraasaanii pireezidaantii waliinii ta’anii akka muudaman gochuudhaan aangoo isaanii jabeeffataa jiru.

title: AFC president doubles down on FIFA, calling World Cup plan ‘unacceptable’
english: The president of the Asian Football Confederation, Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa, has strongly criticized FIFA for its plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors without prior consultation. He argues that this unilateral move threatens the existing structure of international football and demands a more transparent review process. Additionally, the AFC expressed concern over the short timeframe provided for member associations to approve this major financial proposal.
amharic: የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ሼክ ሳልማን ቢን ኢብራሂም አል ካሊፋ፣ ፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀደውን እቅድ አስቀድሞ ሳያማክር ማቅረቡን በጥብቅ ተቃውመዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ዓለም አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ መዋቅርን አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል የገለጹት ሼክ ሳልማን፣ ጉዳዩ ግልጽ በሆነ የህግ አግባብ እንዲታይ ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ አባል ሀገራት ይህንን ትልቅ የፋይናንስ እቅድ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ እንዲያፀድቁ መገደዳቸው አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ኮንፌዴሬሽኑ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Gamtaa Kubbaa Miillaa Eeshiyaa, Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa, FIFA qooda waancaa addunyaa investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatee marii malee ifa godhuun isaa akka hin fudhatamne ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun sirna kubbaa miillaa idil-addunyaa kan miidhuu fi adeemsa iftoomina qabu akka barbaadu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, gamtichi miseensonni isaanii karoora gurguddaa akkasii akka hatattamaan akka mirkaneessan dhiibbaan irratti uumamuun isaa akka isaan yaaddesse ibseera.

title: Israeli raids and settler attacks intensify across the occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces have arrested at least 15 Palestinians during recent overnight operations throughout the occupied West Bank. Simultaneously, the region is experiencing a surge in violent attacks by Israeli settlers. The United Nations has raised alarms, noting that these incidents of settler-led violence have reached unprecedented levels.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት የምሽት ኦፕሬሽን ቢያንስ 15 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በእስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸሙ የጥቃት ድርጊቶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምረዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው፣ እነዚህ በሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸሙ የጥቃት ድርጊቶች ከምንጊዜውም በላይ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa (West Bank) keessatti halkan guutuu duula gaggeessaniin Palastayinoota 15 ol ta'an to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, weerartoonni Israa'el miidhaa fi haleellaa raawwatan daran dabaleera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, haleellaan weerartootaan raawwatamu kun hanga ammaatti sadarkaa olaanaa irra ga'eera.

title: Attack on northwest Pakistan police post kills 11 officers
english: At least 11 police officers were killed and many others injured during a violent ambush on a security checkpoint in Pakistan's Hangu district near the Afghan border. The attackers utilized explosive-laden drones before engaging in a prolonged gun battle with security forces, resulting in the deaths of 15 militants. While no group has claimed responsibility for this specific attack, it follows a recent surge in regional violence and ongoing tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan.
amharic: በፓኪስታን እና በአፍጋኒስታን ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሃንጉ አውራጃ በፖሊስ ጣቢያ ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 የፖሊስ አባላት ተገድለዋል። አጥቂዎቹ ፈንጂ የጫኑ ድሮኖችን ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ ከጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጋር ረጅም ሰዓታት የቆየ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አድርገው 15 የሚሆኑ አጥቂዎች ተገድለዋል። ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን ለጥቃቱ ኃላፊነቱን የወሰደ አካል ባይኖርም፣ በሁለቱ አገራት ድንበር አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Godina Hangu kan Paakistaanitti argamu keessatti buufata poolisii tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatameen poolisoonni 11 yoo du'an, kanneen biroo hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellicha raawwattoonni kunis dirooniin qaraxoota boombii fe'an fayyadamuun booda, humnoota nageenyaa waliin sa'aatii dheeraaf wal-waraansuun haleeltota 15 ajjeesuun danda'ameera. Haleellaa kanaaf eenyuyyuu harka akka qabu ifatti kan hin ibsine ta'us, naannawa daangaa Paakistaanii fi Afgaanistaanitti waraanni dabalaa dhufuun isaa yaaddoo uumee jira.

title: Several children killed and wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza
english: Israeli military strikes targeted several locations across Gaza overnight, resulting in the deaths and injuries of multiple children. The attacks impacted residential buildings in Gaza City and areas in al-Mawasi where displaced families were living in tents. Eyewitness reports confirm that a significant number of the casualties from these strikes are minors.
