Ragaan ijaan argan akka ibsanitti, miidhaan kun namoota irratti ga'e keessaa ijoolleen baay'een isaanii ta'uun mirkanaa'eera.

title: Why is Saudi Arabia forming a coalition to protect the Red Sea?
english: Saudi Arabia is leading an international effort to create a naval alliance to secure shipping routes in the Red Sea against attacks from Yemen's Houthi rebels. The coalition, which is expected to be based in Riyadh, aims to counter maritime blockades and threats to oil exports that have disrupted global energy supplies. Several nations, including Egypt, Sudan, and Djibouti, have already signaled their intent to join as the kingdom seeks to stabilize the region amidst rising geopolitical tensions.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚደርስባቸውን የባህር ላይ ጥቃቶች ለመከላከል በቀይ ባህር ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ኃይል ጥምረት እየመሰረተች ነው። ይህ ጥምረት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ያለውን የንግድ መርከቦች መስተጓጎል ለመግታት ያለመ ነው። ግብፅን፣ ሱዳንን እና ጅቡቲን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሀገራት ጥምረቱን ለመቀላቀል ፍላጎት ያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤቱም በሪያድ እንደሚቋቋም ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan hujii gamtaa waraana galaanaa idil-addunyaa kan naannoo galaana Diimaa eeguuf karoorfame hogganaa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, finciltota Huutii kan Yaman keessa jiran irraa miidhaan daldala galaanaa fi qulqullina boba'aa addunyaa irratti ga'u dhaabuufi. Biyyoonni akka Gibxii, Sudaan fi Jibuutii gamtaa kana keessatti hirmaachuuf fedhii agarsiisaniiru, akkasumas qaamni kun waajjira isaa Riyaad keessatti akka banu ibsameera.

title: Veteran Ugandan opposition leader collapses in court and in ICU, his wife says
english: Kizza Besigye, a prominent Ugandan opposition leader currently facing treason charges, has been admitted to the ICU after collapsing in court. His wife, Winnie Byanyima, reported that he is unconscious and is refusing medical care from government staff while demanding access to his private physician. Besigye has been in detention since his abduction in Kenya last year, and his case remains a focal point of political tension in Uganda.
amharic: የኡጋንዳው የተቃዋሚ መሪ ኪዛ ቤሲግዬ በክስ ሂደት ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት አቅማቸው ተዳክሞ በመውደቃቸው ወደ ከፍተኛ እንክብካቤ ክፍል (ICU) መግባታቸው ተገለጸ። ባለቤታቸው ዊኒ ብያኒማ እንዳስታወቁት፣ ቤሲግዬ ንቃተ ህሊናቸውን ስተው እንደሚገኙ እና የመንግስት ዶክተሮች እንዲያክሟቸው ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። እሳቸውም የግል ሐኪማቸው እንዲያያቸው ቢጠይቁም፣ እስካሁን በከፍተኛ ጥበቃ ስር በህክምና ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan mormituu biyya Yugaandaa Kizza Besigye mana murtiitti osoo jiranu kufanii, amma hospitaala keessatti wal'aansa hatattamaa (ICU) argachaa jiru. Haati warraa isaanii Wiinii Biyaanimaa akka ibsanitti, Besigye quba hin qaban akkasumas ogeeyyota fayyaa mootummaatiin yaalamuu didanii jiru. Waggaa darbe irraa kaasee hidhaa kan jiran hogganaan kun, himannaa gara jabinaa fi mootummaa fonqolchuun himatamuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Saudi Arabia confirmed to host Asian Champions League Elite finals
english: Saudi Arabia has officially been selected to host the Asian Champions League Elite finals for the next three years. The country previously hosted the first two editions of the tournament following its recent restructuring. This elite competition features top clubs from across the continent and is set to expand its league phase to 32 teams starting in the upcoming season.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ለቀጣዮቹ ሶስት አመታት የእስያ ሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ኤሊት ፍጻሜ ውድድርን ለማስተናገድ በይፋ ተመርጣለች። አገሪቱ ከውድድሩ መዋቅር ለውጥ በኋላ የተካሄዱትን የመጀመሪያዎቹን ሁለት የፍጻሜ ውድድሮች አስተናግዳለች። ይህ ከፍተኛ የክለቦች ውድድር በመላው አህጉሪቱ የሚገኙ ምርጥ ክለቦችን የሚያሳትፍ ሲሆን፣ በሚቀጥለው የውድድር ዘመን የሊግ ምዕራፉን ወደ 32 ቡድኖች ለማሳደግ ታቅዷል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan waggoota sadan dhufaniif tapha xumuraa 'Asian Champions League Elite' akka qopheessitu mirkanaa'eera. Biyyattiin qophiiwwan lamaan darban erga riiformiin taphichaa godhamee booda qopheessitee turte. Dorgommiin kun kilaboota gurguddoo ardittii hunda walitti fiduuf kan qophaaye yoo ta'u, waancaa dhufu irraa jalqabee gareewwan 32 akka hirmaatan taasifameera.

title: Infantino insists FIFA’s World Cup plan is proposal and not ‘obligation’
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has defended a controversial proposal to sell a 20 percent stake in a new $20 billion commercial subsidiary to private investors. The plan faced strong backlash from regional football authorities who felt excluded from the decision-making process. Infantino emphasized that this is only a consultation proposal and not a mandatory change, asserting that FIFA will maintain full control over the sport.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ አዲስ የ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ንዑስ ድርጅት በማቋቋም 20 በመቶ ድርሻውን ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡትን እቅድ ተከላክለዋል። ይህ ሀሳብ በውሳኔ አሰጣጡ ሂደት ውስጥ እንዳልተሳተፉ የሚናገሩ የክልል እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ኢንፋንቲኖ ግን ይህ እቅድ አስገዳጅ ሳይሆን ለውይይት የቀረበ ሃሳብ ብቻ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ፊፋ የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታውን ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንደሚያደርግ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiinoo dhaabbata haaraa guddina isaa doolaara biliyoona 20 ta'uuf qophiirra jiru irratti harka 20 investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatan ittisuun dubbataniiru. Karoorri kun qaamolee kubbaa miillaa naannoowwanii kan mufachiise yoo ta'u, isaanis murtee kana keessatti hirmaachisni akka hin jirre ibsaniiru. Infantiinoon garuu kun dirqama osoo hin taane yaada mariif dhiyaate qofa akka ta'e fi FIFA kubbaa miillaa irratti to'annoo guutuu akka qabaatu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US strikes cause extensive damage on Iran’s Qeshm Island
english: The United States conducted significant military strikes against targets on Iran’s Qeshm Island, resulting in widespread destruction. Iranian officials reported that a residential building was hit, leading to the tragic deaths of two adults and their young child, along with injuries to two other minors. These attacks follow a recent military incident involving the US in Jordan.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአይራን ቂሽም ደሴት ላይ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ጥቃት ከፍተኛ ውድመት ደርሷል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤትን በመምታቱ ሁለት አዋቂዎች እና የአንድ ዓመት የሁለት ዓመት ህጻን ህይወታቸው ሲያልፍ ሁለት ሌሎች ህጻናትም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በዮርዳኖስ ከተፈጸመው የቅርብ ጊዜ የጦርነት እንቅስቃሴ ጋር ተያይዞ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Ameerikaan weerara humnaan guutame naannoo odoollaa Qeshm kan Iraan irratti gaggeessiteen miidhaan bal'aan gahee jira. Aangeyyoonni Iraan akka ibsanitti, weerarichi mana jireenyaa tokko rukutuun isaa abbaa manaa, haadha manaa fi ijoollee isaanii waggaa lamaa ajjeeseera; akkasumas ijoolleen biroo lama midhamaniiru. Weerarri kun tarkaanfii Ameerikaan Yordaanos keessatti mudannoo waraanaa erga mudatee booda fudhatte dha.

title: Is Israel repeating the Crusaders’ fatal mistake?
english: A new Al Jazeera podcast series called 'Deja Vu' investigates historical parallels between the Crusader kingdom and modern Israel. The program examines how the 11th-century Crusader state ultimately collapsed after less than a century due to internal and external pressures. It questions whether current political dynamics suggest that Israel might face a similar fate as it navigates conflicts in the region.
amharic: አልጀዚራ 'ዴጃ ቩ' በተሰኘ አዲስ የፖድካስት ፕሮግራሙ፣ በመካከለኛው ዘመን የነበረው የመስቀላውያን መንግሥት እና አሁን ያለው የእስራኤል ሁኔታ ያላቸውን ተመሳሳይነት ይዳስሳል። ፕሮግራሙ የ11ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን የመስቀላውያን ግዛት ከውስጥ እና ከውጭ በተፈጠሩ ጫናዎች እንዴት በአንድ ክፍለ ዘመን ባልሞላ ጊዜ ውስጥ እንደወደቀ ይተነትናል። ይህንንም ታሪካዊ ክስተት መሰረት በማድረግ፣ አሁን ያለው የእስራኤል የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ተመሳሳይ ውድቀት ሊገጥመው ይችላል ወይ የሚለውን ጥያቄ ያነሳል።
oromo: Podcastiin 'Deja Vu' jedhamu kan Al Jazeera, walitti dhufeenya seenaa Mootummaa Masqalootaa (Crusaders) fi haala yeroo ammaa Israa'el gidduu jiru qorata. Sagantaan kun, mootummaan Masqalootaa bara 1099 hundeeffame dhiibbaa gara garaatiin waggaa dhibba tokko hin guunne keessatti akkamitti akka kufe ibsa. Seenaa kana kaasuun, haalli siyaasaa fi waraana har'aa Israa'el keessa jiru gara fuulduraatti bu'aa wal-fakkaataa qabaachuu danda'a moo miti kan jedhu gaaffii keessa galcha.

title: India’s arms sale to Israel risks complicity in Gaza genocide, Amnesty says
english: Amnesty International has accused India of facilitating potential war crimes by supplying military components to Israel during the conflict in Gaza. A report reveals that Indian companies have shipped hundreds of thousands of parts for weapons, explosives, and military vehicles to Israeli defense manufacturers since October 2023. The organization argues that these exports make India complicit in the humanitarian crisis, urging a halt to such shipments amid ongoing international legal concerns regarding genocide.
amharic: አምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል ህንድ በጋዛ በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ወቅት ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ መለዋወጫዎችን በማቅረብ ለጦር ወንጀሎች ተባባሪ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ከሰሰ። የቡድኑ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው፣ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ የህንድ ኩባንያዎች በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የጦር መሳሪያ፣ የፈንጂ እና ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪ መለዋወጫዎችን ለእስራኤል የመከላከያ አምራቾች ልከዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ህንድ በሰብአዊ ቀውሱ ውስጥ ተባባሪ እንድትሆን እንደሚያደርጋት የገለጸው ድርጅቱ፣ እየተባባሰ በመጣው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ክስ ምክንያት ህንድ እነዚህን የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦቶች እንድታቆም አሳስቧል።
oromo: Amnesty International akka gabaasetti, Hindaan waraana Gaaza keessatti raawwatamaa jiruuf meeshaalee waraanaa Israa’eliif dhiyeessuun yakka waraanaa keessatti hirmaachuu danda’uun himateera. Gabaasichi akka ibsutti, Hindaan qondaaltota Israa’el waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qabaachuun, Onkoloolessa 2023 irraa eegalee meeshaalee waraanaa, rasaasa fi kutaalee konkolaataa waraanaa hedduu gara Israa’elitti ergaa tureera. Dhaabbatichi, gochi kun Hindaan balaa namoomaa fi yakka sanyii balleessuu irratti harka akka qabaattu taasisa jedhee waan amanuuf, dhiyeessii kana akka dhaabdu gaafateera.

title: Israeli air attacks kill six Palestinians in Gaza overnight
english: Israeli airstrikes conducted overnight across the Gaza Strip have resulted in the deaths of six Palestinians and left 25 others injured. These new casualties are part of an ongoing military campaign in the region. Medical officials have confirmed the rising toll as the intense bombardment continues.
amharic: ባለፈው ሌሊት በተለያዩ የጋዛ ሰርጥ አካባቢዎች በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ 25 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ቀጣይ የቦምብ ድብደባ የሟቾችን ቁጥር ከፍ አድርጎታል። የሕክምና ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ጉዳቱ እየጨመረ መምጣቱን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Halkan darbe qilleensa irraa haleellaa Israa'el naannoo Gazaatti gaggeessiteen namoonni ja'a ajjeefamanii 25 ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun tarkaanfii waraana biyyattii kan daangaa tokko malee itti fufe keessatti kan dabalameedha. Maddi oduu fayyaa akka mirkaneessetti, haleellaa hammaataa kanaan baay'inni namoota miidhamanii dabalaa jira.

title: Why the New York Times story on Mossad recruiting Ahmadinejad doesn't add up
english: A recent New York Times report claims that Israel's intelligence agency, the Mossad, recruited former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad to influence Iran's political future. However, experts and former intelligence officials argue the story is highly improbable, noting that Ahmadinejad lacks the real power held by Iran's Supreme Leader and the Revolutionary Guard. Furthermore, the operational details, such as the Mossad chief personally meeting the former president at a public conference, contradict standard security protocols.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ታይምስ የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባ የእስራኤል የደህንነት መስሪያ ቤት ሞሳድ፣ የቀድሞውን የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማህሙድ አህመዲኔጃድን የአገሪቱን የፖለቲካ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ለመቆጣጠር እንደላከው ይናገራል። ሆኖም ባለሙያዎች እና የቀድሞ የደህንነት ባለስልጣናት ታሪኩ ተአማኒነት የሌለው መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ አህመዲኔጃድ በኢራን ከፍተኛ መሪዎች እና በሪቮሉሽነሪ ጋርድ ዘንድ ምንም አይነት ትክክለኛ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው ይገልጻሉ። በተጨማሪም፣ የሞሳድ ዋና ዳይሬክተር በግል በይፋዊ ኮንፈረንስ ላይ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንቱን መገናኘታቸው ተራ የአሰራር ደንቦችን የሚጻረር በመሆኑ ታሪኩ ጥርጣሬን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni 'New York Times' dhiheenya kana baase, mootummaan Israa'el fi sagantaan basaastota ishee 'Mossad' pirezidaantii duraanii Iraan Maahmuda Ahimadiinejaad, gara fuulduraatti bulchiinsa Iraan to'achuuf akka fayyadaman hima. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyiin fi basaastonnii duraanii himata kana kan morman yoo ta'u, Ahimadiinejaad humna siyaasaa dhugaa kan qaban hoggantoota olaanoo fi waraana 'Revolutionary Guard' ta'uu isaa eeru. Kana malee, hogganaan Mossad akkaataa namoota gidduutti wal arguun isaa fi yaadni walga'ii idilee irratti wal arguu qabatamaa miti jedhamee shakkama.

title: Egypt says drone attack sparked fire on American LNG ships
english: Egyptian authorities have confirmed that a drone attack triggered a fire on two American-owned natural gas vessels at the port of Damietta. While no injuries were reported and no group has claimed responsibility, officials have launched a formal investigation into the security breach. This incident has sparked concerns that the ongoing regional conflict is expanding, as it is the first such attack on Egyptian soil during the current crisis.
amharic: የግብፅ ባለስልጣናት በዳሚዬታ ወደብ በሚገኙ ሁለት የአሜሪካ የጋዝ ማጓጓዣ መርከቦች ላይ የደረሰው የእሳት አደጋ በድሮን ጥቃት መከሰቱን አረጋግጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው ባይኖርም እና ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው አካል ባይታወቅም፣ መንግስት የጸጥታ ጥሰቱን በቁም ነገር በመመልከት ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ ጥቃት አሁን ባለው የክልሉ ግጭት ውስጥ ግብፅን በአዲስ መልክ ማካተቱ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Masrii dooniiwwan gaazii kan Ameerikaa lama kan buufata Damietta keessatti gubatan, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (drone) akka ta'e mirkaneesseera. Namni miidhame akka hin jirre fi gareen haleellaa kana fudhate akka hin jirre kan ibsame yoo ta'u, mootummaan qorannoo eegalee jira. Haleellaan kun lola naannichaa keessatti Masriin akka hirmaattu godhuun isaa sodaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Israeli drones target southern Lebanese town in Tyre
english: Israeli drones conducted an aerial strike on the Mashaa al-Mansouri region near the city of Tyre in southern Lebanon. Official reports from Lebanese state media indicate that the attack took place recently. Authorities have not yet released any information regarding potential injuries or the extent of the property damage caused by the assault.
amharic: የእስራኤል ድሮኖች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የታየር ከተማ አካባቢ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። የሊባኖስ የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደዘገቡት ጥቃቱ በማሻ አል-ማንሱሪ አካባቢ የተፈጸመ ነው። እስካሁን ድረስ በደረሰው ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ወይም የንብረት ውድመት ስለመኖሩ የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Xiyyaaronni malee kan Israa'el magaalaa Xaayir kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Libaanoos akka gabaasanitti, haleellaan kun naannoo Maashaa al-Mansuuritti kan raawwatame dha. Hammamtaan miidhaa lubbuu fi qabeenyaa haleellaa kanaan ga'ee hanga ammaatti ifatti hin ba'in jiru.

title: Watch: Search operations for victims of US strike in Qeshm, where three were found killed
english: Iranian state media released footage showing rescue workers searching through the debris of a home on Qeshm Island after a US military strike. The attack resulted in the deaths of three family members, including a young child. Two other children survived the incident and have been taken to a hospital for medical care.
amharic: የኢራን የመንግስት ሚዲያ በኬሽም ደሴት ላይ በአሜሪካ የደረሰው የአየር ጥቃት የመኖሪያ ቤትን እንዳፈረሰ የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርጓል። በዚህ ጥቃት አንድ ሕፃንን ጨምሮ የአንድ ቤተሰብ ሦስት አባላት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ሁለት የተረፉ ልጆች ደግሞ ለሕክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተልከዋል።
oromo: Miidiyaan mootummaa Iraan akka gabaasetti, haleellaa qilleensaa Ameerikaan odoola Qeshm irratti raawwatteen mana jireenyaa tokko diigameera. Haleellaa kanaan miseensonni maatii sadii kan du’an yoo ta’u, isaan keessaa daa’imni tokko ni argama. Daa’imman sadarkaa kana irraa lubbuun hafan lama immoo yaala argachuuf gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru.

title: Viral finger-clicker suspended as cricket storm remains in global spotlight
english: An amateur cricketer from Saltburn Cricket Club has been suspended indefinitely following allegations that he used finger-clicking to deceive umpires. The player allegedly mimicked the sound of the ball hitting the bat to incorrectly influence decisions, with video evidence of the act gaining international attention. The club is currently working with the local league to investigate the incident and has asked for privacy during the process.
amharic: የሰልትበርን ክሪኬት ክለብ ተጫዋች ዳኞችን ለማታለል በጣት የመጫጫን ድምፅ ተጠቅሟል በሚል ክስ ከጨዋታ ታግዷል። ተጫዋቹ ኳሱ ከባት ጋር እንደተገናኘ ለማስመሰል የጣት ድምፅ በማውጣት ዳኞችን ለማሳሳት ሞክሯል የሚለው ቪዲዮ ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረት አግኝቷል። ክለቡ ከሊጉ ጋር በመተባበር ጉዳዩን እያጣራ ሲሆን፣ ምርመራው እስኪጠናቀቅ ድረስ ተጫዋቹ ከማንኛውም ውድድር ታግዶ እንዲቆይ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Taphatni kilabii kirikeetii Saltburn tokko, abbaa murtiin (umpire) akka dogoggoruuf quba isaa walitti rukutuudhaan sagalee sobaa uume jedhamee shakkamee addunyaa irratti hordofamaa jira. Taphatni kun kubbaan biitii (bat) irra gaheera jedhanii akka yaadaniif sagalee sobaa uumuu isaa viidiyoon agarsiisu kun babal’ateera. Kilabichi dhimma kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiruuf taphaticha yeroo hin murtoofneef tapha irraa dhorkeera.

title: War and shortages push Gaza hospitals to breaking point
english: Gaza’s healthcare system is facing a catastrophic collapse due to ongoing conflict and severe supply shortages. Vital medical facilities have been destroyed or forced to close, leaving thousands of patients, including those needing dialysis, without life-saving treatment. Consequently, individuals suffering from chronic conditions and trauma are dying at alarming rates as hospitals struggle to operate with limited resources.
amharic: በጋዛ ያለው የጤና አገልግሎት በጦርነቱ እና በህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመፈራረስ አደጋ ተጋርጦበታል። አስፈላጊ የህክምና ተቋማት በመውደማቸው ወይም በመዘጋታቸው የኩላሊት እጥበት የሚያስፈልጋቸው ታካሚዎችን ጨምሮ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ህይወት አድን ህክምና ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ በከባድ ህመም እና በጦርነቱ ጉዳት ላይ ያሉ ሰዎች በቂ ድጋፍ ማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየሞቱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: sirni fayyaa Gaaza keessaa waraanaafi hanqina meeshaalee wal’aansaa irraa kan ka’e kufaatii hamaa keessa jira. Buufatni fayyaa hedduun kan manca’aniifi cufaman yoo ta’u, kunis dhukkubsattoota hedduu keessattuu kanneen dhiiga dhiqachuu qaban du’aaf saaxilee jira. Sababa hanqina meeshaaleefi rakkoo hospitaalotaa kanaan, namoonni dhukkuba cimaafi miidhaa waraanaan qabaman wal’aansa argachuu dadhabanii lubbuun isaanii darbaa jira.

title: US launches ‘powerful’ strikes on Iran after Jordan attack
english: The United States military has carried out a series of intense airstrikes against several cities in southern Iran, including Ahvaz and Abadan. This operation was conducted as a direct response to a previous attack on American forces stationed in Jordan. President Donald Trump emphasized that these strikes were intended to be a significant retaliatory measure against the Iranian government.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በአህቫዝ እና በአባዳንን ጨምሮ በደቡባዊ ኢራን በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ድብደባዎችን ፈጽመዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በዮርዳኖስ ውስጥ በሰፈሩ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ላይ ለደረሰው ጥቃት አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ይህ እርምጃ በኢራን ላይ የሚወሰድ ጠንካራ ምላሽ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa magaalota kibba Iraan kanneen akka Ahvaaz fi Abadaanitti haleellaa xiyyaaraa cimaa gaggeesseera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame loltoota Ameerikaa Yordaanos keessa turan irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda haaloo bahuufidha. Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp tarkaanfiin kun mootummaa Iraan irratti kan xiyyeeffate fi humna guddaa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Evo Morales defiant after new Bolivia arrest warrant
english: Bolivian authorities have issued a new arrest warrant for former President Evo Morales, accusing him of terrorism and orchestrating an armed uprising. These charges stem from his recent support for widespread protests against the government's economic policies. Morales has dismissed the allegations as a political tactic to distract from the country's ongoing crisis and has vowed not to be intimidated.
amharic: የቦሊቪያ ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ኤቮ ሞራሌስን በአሸባሪነት እና በመንግስት ላይ የታጠቀ አመጽ በማቀጣጠል በመክሰስ አዲስ የእስር ማዘዣ አውጥተዋል። ክሱ የተመሰረተው በመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ የተነሱ ተቃውሞዎችን በመደገፋቸው ነው። ሞራሌስ ክሱ የሀገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ለመሸፈን የተደረገ ፖለቲካዊ ሴራ ነው በማለት ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Boliviyaa dura taa'aa biyyattii kan turan Evo Morales irratti, shororkeessummaa fi mootummaa irratti fincila hidhannootti fayyadame kaasuun himatamanii ajajni qabamuu bahee jira. Himannoon kun kan dhufe erga isaan mootummaan qophee siyaasa dinagdee isaa mormuun hiriira bahanii turan booda. Morales himannoo kana mootummaan rakkoo dinagdee biyyattii jiru dhoksuuf jecha irratti dhiyeessan jechuun waakkatan.

title: Rescue operation in Argentina to free more than 100 snow-trapped tourists
english: Emergency teams in Argentina successfully rescued over 100 tourists who were stranded by a heavy snowstorm near the Balcon del Pissis lookout. Authorities utilized heavy equipment to reach the trapped individuals and clear the blocked paths. While most were rescued safely, two people required medical treatment for hypothermia.
amharic: በአርጀንቲና ባልኮን ዴል ፒሲስ አካባቢ በበረዶ አውሎ ንፋስ ተይዘው የነበሩ ከ100 በላይ ቱሪስቶች በአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ድነት ተደረገላቸው። አዳኝ ቡድኖች በረዶውን ለማጽዳት ከባድ ማሽነሪዎችን ተጠቅመዋል። አብዛኛዎቹ ተጎጂዎች በሰላም የተረፉ ሲሆን፣ ሁለት ሰዎች በብርድ ምክንያት ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተልከዋል።
oromo: Arjantiinaatti turistoonni 100 ol ta'an naannoo Balcon del Pissis jedhamutti obomboleettii cabbii cimaan erga itti cufamee booda gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa lubbuun hafan. Gareen furmaataa cabbicha kaasuuf maashinoota guguddaa kan fayyadaman yoo ta'u, namoonni hundinuus nageenyaan baafamaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, namoonni lama qorri isaan miidhee gara hospitaalaatti geessisuun isaan barbaachiseera.

title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
english: The United States military conducted significant retaliatory strikes against Iran after Iranian forces attempted to attack American troops in Jordan and naval vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Although all incoming Iranian missiles were intercepted, the US responded by destroying numerous military command centers, drone facilities, and defense sites linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. These hostilities mark an escalation in a five-month-long conflict that continues despite earlier hopes for diplomatic negotiations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በዮርዳኖስ እና በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ላይ በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር የሞከረውን ኢራን በመበቀል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ምንም እንኳን ሁሉም የኢራን ሚሳኤሎች ቢከሽፉም፣ አሜሪካ በምላሹ የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይሎች መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከላትን እና የጦር መሣሪያ ማከማቻዎችን አውድማለች። ይህ ግጭት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ይገኛል ተብሎ ቢታሰብም፣ ለአምስት ወራት ያህል እየተባባሰ የቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Amerikaa, humnoonni Iraan buufata Amerikaa kan Yordaanos keessa jiruufi markaboota galaanaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf yaalii taasisan hordofee, deebii cimaa kenneera. Haleellaan Iraan yaalame kun hundi akka fashala’e kan himame yoo ta’u, Amerikaan immoo deebii kanaan giddugala ajaja waraanaa fi buufataalee meeshaalee waraanaa Iraan hedduu barbadeessiteetti. Hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii kun marii nagaa dhabee ji’oota shanf dura kan jalqabame yoo ta’u, ammas ittuma fufee jira.

title: Dramatic sea rescue as firefighters die on the Greek island of Crete
english: Severe wildfires on the Greek island of Crete have necessitated an emergency sea rescue operation by the Coast Guard for those trapped by the flames. Tragically, three firefighters have lost their lives while attempting to combat these blazes, including two on the island and one on the mainland. Authorities are currently working to manage the disaster as the fires continue to pose a significant threat.
amharic: በግሪክ የቀርጤስ ደሴት ላይ የተቀሰቀሰው የደን ቃጠሎ ለሕዝብ ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመፍጠሩ የባህር ጠረፍ ጠባቂዎች ሰዎችን ለማዳን እየሰሩ ነው። በእሳት አደጋው ወቅት የደረሰው አደጋ ሁለት የእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞችን በደሴቲቱ፣ አንዱን ደግሞ በዋናው መሬት ላይ በመግደል የሦስት ሰዎችን ሕይወት ቀጥፏል። ባለሥልጣናት እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እና የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Odola Giriiki kan ta'e Kiriteetti ibidda bosonaa cimaa mudateen walqabatee, namoota ibiddaan marfaman oolchuuf gargaarsi qarqara galaanaa hatattamaa ta'e taasifamaa jira. Balaa kanaan, dhaamsitoota ibiddaa sadet du'aniiru; isaan keessaa lama odolicha keessatti yoo ta'an, tokko ammoo lafa guddaa Giriikiirratti lubbuun darbeera. Mootummaan ibidda kana dhaamsuu fi namoota balaaf saaxilaman oolchuuf humnaa ol hojjechaa jira.

title: Why did Anthony Fauci invoke the Fifth Amendment? Senate hearing explained
english: Former US health official Dr. Anthony Fauci recently refused to answer questions at a Senate hearing concerning the COVID-19 pandemic and its origins. Following advice from his legal team, he utilized his Fifth Amendment right to avoid potential self-incrimination while facing intense scrutiny from Republican lawmakers. These officials, led by Senator Rand Paul, are investigating allegations that Fauci misled Congress regarding US-funded research linked to the virus.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ የጤና ባለሙያ ዶክተር አንቶኒ ፋውቺ በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ መነሻ እና አያያዝ ዙሪያ በሴኔት ኮሚቴ ቀርበው ጥያቄዎችን ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ጠበቆቻቸው በሰጡት ምክር መሰረት፣ ሊከተል የሚችለውን የህግ ተጠያቂነት ለመከላከል ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን በመጠቀም ዝምታን መርጠዋል። የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ዶክተሩ ኮንግረስን አሳስተዋል በሚል ክስ ምርመራ እያካሄዱ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በቻይና ስላደረጉት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የተደረገለት ምርምርን የሚመለከት ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan tajaajila fayyaa Ameerikaa durii Dr. Anthony Fauci, waa'ee maddaa fi to'annoo dhukkuba COVID-19 ilaalchisee yaa'ii mana maree (Senate) irratti gaaffii deebisuuf fedhii hin qabne. Gareen abukaattota isaa akka gorfetti, ofiin of yakkuuf karaa banuu danda'a jedhee waan sodaateef, mirga isaa kan seera bu'uuraa biyyattii fayyadamuun deebii kennuu dideera. Senatorootni paartii Ripaabilikaanii Dr. Fauci qorannoo Chaayinaa keessatti taasifame irratti Congress gowwoomseera jedhanii waan shakkanif qorannoo kana gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Living with fear: Inside a southern Lebanon village divided by Israel
english: The village of Mansouri in southern Lebanon remains split by a military border known as the Yellow Line, which separates a small portion of occupied Lebanese land from the rest of the country. Residents living near this boundary face daily uncertainty and constant anxiety due to the proximity of Israeli military presence. The ongoing situation has left the local population in a state of persistent fear as they navigate life in a deeply divided territory.
amharic: የደቡብ ሊባኖሷ ማንሱሪ መንደር እስራኤል በቆረጠችው ወታደራዊ የድንበር መስመር ምክንያት ለሁለት ተከፍላለች። ይህ ድንበር የሊባኖስን የተወሰነ መሬት ከሌላው የአገሪቱ ክፍል የሚለይ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎቹም በዚህ ወታደራዊ ይዞታ አቅራቢያ በመኖራቸው በየቀኑ ከፍተኛ ፍርሃትና ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው። በተከፈለው አካባቢ የሚኖሩት እነዚህ ሰዎች እየጨመረ በመጣው የጸጥታ ችግር ምክንያት አስቸጋሪ ሕይወት እየገፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ganda Mansuurii kan kibba Libaanositti argamu, sararri daangaa waraanaa kan 'Yellow Line' jedhamu kutaatti qooda. Daangaan kun lafa Libaanos irraa qabame kan gargar baasu yoo ta'u, jiraattonni naannoo sanaa waraana Israa'elitti dhihoo waan jiraniif sodaafi yaaddoo cimaa keessa jiru. Haala yeroo ammaa uumame kanaan, jiraattonni kun naannoo qoodame kana keessa jiraachuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: After a deadly raid, a displaced Nigerian mother finds a lifeline in sewing
english: Safiya Musa, a Nigerian mother who lost her husband and two children during a violent bandit raid, has managed to rebuild her life by learning to sew. After fleeing her home to live in a camp for displaced people, she now earns a living making bags to support her surviving children. Despite finding stability through this new skill, she faces the difficult dilemma of whether to return to her dangerous hometown or remain in the camp to protect her hard-earned independence.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ የታጠቁ ቡድኖች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት ባለቤቷንና ሁለት ልጆቿን ያጣችው ሳፊያ ሙሳ፣ ስፌት በመማር ህይወቷን እንደገና መገንባት ችላለች። ከቀያቸው ተፈናቅለው መጠለያ ካምፕ የምትኖረው ሳፊያ፣ ቦርሳዎችን በመስፋት ለቀሩት ልጆቿ መተዳደሪያ ማግኘት ችላለች። ሆኖም አሁን ወደ ቀድሞ መንደሯ የመመለስና ያገኘችውን ነፃነት የማጣት ስጋት ውስጥ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Haati biyya Naayijeeriyaa Safiyaa Musaa jedhamtu, haleellaa hidhattootaa kanaan abbaa manaa fi ijoollee ishii lama erga dhabdee booda, hojii hodhinsaa barachuun jireenya ishii deebitee dhaabuuf carraaqxetti. Qayee ishii irraa buqqaatee buufata godaantotaa keessa kan jiraattu Safiyaan, amma baddee fi boorsaa hodhuun ijoollee ishii hafan guddifachaa jirti. Ta'us, amala kanaan of danda'uu erga eegaltee booda, gara mana ishiitti deebi'uu fi jireenya haaraa ijaarratte kana dhabuuf sodaa guddaa keessa jirti.

title: Japan turns to Canadian crude as Asia feels Hormuz supply pinch
english: Japan has begun importing crude oil from Canada via the Trans Mountain pipeline to reduce its reliance on energy supplies from the Strait of Hormuz. This shift follows regional instability caused by the war on Iran, which has significantly disrupted traditional oil routes and impacted Japan’s economic growth. Several other Asian nations are also increasing their purchases of Canadian oil to ensure a more secure and diversified supply chain.
amharic: ጃፓን ከሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ የሚገኘውን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ የካናዳ ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ወደ ሀገሯ ማስገባት ጀምራለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው በኢራን ላይ በተከፈተው ጦርነት ምክንያት በአካባቢው የተፈጠረውን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ተከትሎ ነው። ጃፓንን ጨምሮ ሌሎች የእስያ ሀገራትም ለኢኮኖሚያቸው ደህንነት ሲባል የነዳጅ ምንጫቸውን ለመቀያየር የካናዳን ምርት እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Japan hirkummaa boba'aa 'Strait of Hormuz' irraa qabdu hir'isuuf jecha, boba'aa Canada irraa gara biyya ishee galchuu jalqabdeetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraana Iran irratti geggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee dhiyeessiin boba'aa addunyaa waan gufatee fi. Japan dabalatee biyyoonni Eshiyaa kaan, tasgabbii dhiyeessii boba'aa isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf jecha, Canada irraa boba'aa bitachuu isaanii dabaluu irra jiru.

title: Trump met with Saudi defence minister after joint strikes on Iraq: Report
english: President Trump recently held urgent talks with the Saudi Defense Minister following joint military actions in Iraq. During the meeting, Prince Khalid bin Salman emphasized that Saudi Arabia prefers regional de-escalation rather than increased conflict with Iran. The Saudis also expressed concern that Israeli leadership is actively encouraging a wider war, which contradicts Saudi Arabia's goals for stability.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራቅ ውስጥ ከተካሄደ የጋራ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ በኋላ ከሳዑዲ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ጋር አስቸኳይ ውይይት አድርገዋል። በስብሰባው ወቅት ልዑል ካሊድ ቢን ሳልማን ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከኢራን ጋር ግጭት ከመፍጠር ይልቅ የክልሉን ሰላም ማቀዝቀዝ እንደምትመርጥ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል መንግስት ጦርነቱን ለማባባስ እየገፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ይህ አካሄድ የሳዑዲ አረቢያን የሰላም ፍላጎት እንደሚቃረን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp Iraaq keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa waloo erga fudhatanii booda, ministira ittisa biyya Sa’udii waliin marii ariifachiisaa ta’e taasisaniiru. Marii kanaan, Amiir Khaalid biin Salmaan Sa’udin waliin gahiinsa waraanaa Iran waliin dabaluu mannaa, nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa buusuu akka barbaaddu ibsaniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan Israa’el waraana babal’isuuf yaalaa akka jiru fi kunis fedhii Sa’udii kan faallessu ta’uu himaniiru.

title: Centcom says two hours-long wave of strikes against Iran 'successfully completed'
english: The U.S. Central Command recently executed a series of targeted airstrikes against various military locations in Iran, including command centers and weapons facilities. These operations were launched as a direct retaliatory measure following an attempted missile attack on American forces. Officials confirmed that the extensive two-hour mission was completed successfully.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በኢራን ወታደራዊ ማዕከላት፣ የጦር መሣሪያ ማከማቻዎች እና ሌሎች ቁልፍ ቦታዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ተከታታይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽሟል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ላይ የተፈጸመውን የሚሳይል ጥቃት ተከትሎ የተወሰዱ የመልስ እርምጃዎች ናቸው። ለሁለት ሰዓታት የዘለቀው ይህ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን በስኬት መጠናቀቁን የዕዙ መግለጫ ያመለክታል።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (CENTCOM) lafa waraanaafi giddugaleessa meeshaalee waraanaa Iran keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, humnoota Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa misaayilii gaggeessuuf yaalamee tureef haaloo ba'uufi. Hojiin waraanaa sa'aatii lamaaf turu kun milkiin xumuramuusaa hoggantoonni ibsaniiru.

title: More explosions reported in Iran, two children wounded by US strike in Qeshm Island
english: Multiple explosions have been reported across southern Iran, including in the city of Ahvaz. On Qeshm Island, a residential home was hit by a US military strike, leaving two children injured. Rescue teams are currently searching the wreckage to locate three other family members who remain trapped.

These attacks targeted several key areas, such as Abadan and Bandar Abbas, marking a significant escalation in tensions.

title: Trump cuts WHO off from Gavi vaccine alliance funding
english: The Trump administration has announced it will provide $600 million to the vaccine alliance Gavi while explicitly barring the World Health Organization from receiving any of these funds. This decision is part of an ongoing conflict between President Trump and the UN health agency, which he has previously accused of poor management during the COVID-19 pandemic. To secure this continued support, the US has mandated that Gavi implement specific reforms, including the phasing out of mercury in vaccines.

Murteen kun walitti bu'insa dheeraa Prezidaant Traampii fi Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa gidduu jiru kan calaqqisiisu yoo ta'u, Traamp duraan dhaabbatichi wayita weerara vaayrasii koroonaatti hojii isaa sirnaan hin baane jedhanii komataa turan. title: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv come after Zelenskyy’s warning
english: Russia recently launched ballistic missile strikes against Kyiv, resulting in fires at non-residential buildings. english: The United States has carried out significant retaliatory strikes against Iranian targets following a deadly ballistic missile attack on an American military base in Jordan. title: Saudi Arabia seeks international coalition against Houthis in Red Sea
english: Saudi Arabia is working to form an international coalition to protect Red Sea shipping lanes from Houthi rebel attacks. title: Nicaragua’s Daniel Ortega aims to bar ‘traitors’ from future elections
english: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega has proposed constitutional changes that would bar opposition members labeled as traitors from running in future elections. title: How Israeli settler terrorism threatens the basics of Palestinian survival
english: Escalating violence by Israeli settlers and strict military restrictions in the occupied West Bank are severely hindering Palestinians' access to essential healthcare.
